info.title: Kombine Flex Portal API
info.description:
Build your own portal or agent using **HTTPS and JSON**.

### Get started

1. Call `LoginManager` with your manager credentials.
2. Copy `accessToken` into **Authorize → ManagerBearer**. Paste only the token; Swagger adds the `Bearer` prefix.
3. Call `GetCurrentManager` to read your profile, tabs, scopes and operation rights.

No API key, OAuth client registration or special agent protocol is required.

### Tenant and language

- **Host:** `api.{tenant}.kombine.technology` or `beta.api.{tenant}.kombine.technology`. Tokens are bound to the tenant hostname and deployment environment. Unknown hosts return HTTP 400.
- **Language:** send `Accept-Language`, for example `da-DK` or `en-GB`, to localize unit-name placeholders. `Content-Language` identifies the selected language; English is the default.
- **Anonymous access:** select **Public v1 (no login)** above for status, statistics, the purchase map and icon images rendered from local assets.
- **File downloads:** select **Downloads v1** above for resident CSV, account CSV/Excel, settlement ZIP and document CSV/XLS exports. Reuse your manager bearer token.

### Available operations

Services1 adds `GetServices`, `GetService` and `SetServiceProfileField` for predefined services. Only names and icons can be edited directly; API-key hashes are read-only. `GenerateServiceApiKey` creates a key starting with `kt_` and stores its password-compatible hash. Requires Service Read and tenant-wide access; editing/generation also requires Service Write. Key generation does not issue bearer tokens.

| Area | Operations and access |
| --- | --- |
| Hosting | `GetHostingMetrics` reads DigitalOcean app and Managed MySQL metrics. Requires Hosting1, Managers Read and a whole-tenant KID grant. Metrics cover the shared infrastructure across customers. See [hosting metrics](../docs#hosting). |
| Tenant status | `GetTenantStatus` runs Offline and AutoOutOfOrder lookups in parallel. Requires TenantStatus1, Bank/Location/Unit Read and matching KID scope. Check each source for failure or truncation. See [operational alerts](../docs#tenant-status). |
| Profile | `GetCurrentManager` returns your current access. `GetMyManagerProfile` / `SetMyManagerProfileField` read/edit your own name, organisation, person icon, theme and RetentionDays (deleted-record visibility within existing access). `RequestMyManagerEmailVerification` / `ConfirmMyManagerEmail` verify a new mailbox; `ChangeMyManagerPassword` requires the current password and matching new entries. `SetCurrentManagerTheme` also saves your preference: System = 0, Light = 1, Dark = 2. See [personal settings](../docs#my-settings). |
| Installers | `GetInstallers` lists installer IDs, names, email, locations, tags, state and activity with filtering and paging. `GetInstaller` reads details and the Person icon catalogue. Both reads require Installers1, Installer Read and tenant-wide access; `SetInstallerIcon` additionally requires Installer Write and the current icon revision. |
| Administrators | `GetManagers` lists administrators; `GetManager` reads one canonical manager KID. Both require Managers1, Managers Read and tenant-wide access. `SetManagerPermission` edits one bit; `SetManagerPermissionRole` applies a complete predefined matrix atomically. Both writes additionally require Managers Write; own permissions are editable only for the sole active tenant-wide manager. |
| Residents | `GetBankUsers`, `GetBankUserWorkspace` and `ExportBankUsers` provide authorized Users2 lists, workspace details and bounded CSV export. `CreateBankUser` and `ExecuteBankUserCommand` require bank-wide scope, revision checks and the operation-specific User flags. `GetBankUserActivation` requires User Create. |
| Resident receipts | `GetUserReceipts` returns complete receipts with currency-separated totals and balances, twenty at a time. Requires Users2, User Read and bank-wide scope. Continue with the returned revision and nextOffset. See [receipts](../docs#user-receipts). |
| Locations and units | `GetBankLocations` and `GetLocationUnits` provide authorized overviews, including unit types. `GetUnitIcons` lazily adds online/offline status; `GetLocationIcons` aggregates authorized units into a location status icon; `GetBankIcons` does the same across the bank's authorized locations. `GetUnitOverview` returns the unit's setting/state groups; `GetUnitGroup` reads values, sync flags, editors and edit constraints. `GetUnitSettingHistory` pages through a setting's changes on demand. `SetUnitSetting` saves with Unit Write and revision protection. States remain read-only. |
| Settlements | `GetBankSettlements`, `GetBankSettlementPeriod` and `DownloadBankSettlement` provide read-only history, provisional totals and ZIP downloads. |
| Opening hours | `GetLocationOpeningHours` returns grouped weekly schedules, dated exceptions, nullable opening status and the next change in the location time zone. Same scope and read permissions as the location/unit overview. See [opening hours](../docs#location-opening-hours). |
| Reservation rules | `GetLocationBookingRules` returns configured rules for visible units, grouped by calendar and complete policy. Localized plain text, stable codes and explicit warnings; not a resident-specific availability check. Same scope and read permissions as the location/unit overview. See [reservation rules](../docs#location-booking-rules). |
| Reservations | `GetBankBookings` and `ExecuteBankBookingCommand` support Bookings1 lists, cancellation and restoration. Commands require Unit Write; event KIDs supply concurrency checks. |
| Consumption | `GetBankAccount` and `ExportBankAccount` honor location grants. `ReverseBankAccountEntry` requires bank-wide scope and Bank/User Write. |

`GetCurrentManager.databaseAccess` is a cached indicator for the workspace footer. It does not grant manager permissions or guarantee writes to every bank. See each operation for its complete access requirements.

**Integration guides:** [English](../docs) · [Dansk](../docs/da) · [Español](../docs/es)

get.summary: Lists Account2 postings with full-selection totals per currency.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires **Account2** and **Bank, Location, Unit and User Read**.
- Location grants limit the rows, totals and available filter choices.
- No business data is read when access is denied.
            
### Filters and paging
            
- Defaults to **today** in `Europe/Copenhagen`. Both dates are inclusive; the maximum interval is **367 days**.
- An explicit `period` replaces the date filter.
- Sorted newest first, then by location and unit.
- `offset`: **0–100,000**. `limit`: **1–200**, default **50**. Responses are not cached.
            
### Settlement periods
            
- The latest **100 closed period IDs** come from bank-level **LogA**.
- With location-limited access, each offered period must also contain an authorized **Log1** posting.
- Period **0** remains explicitly selectable. Any nonnegative period can be requested explicitly.
            
### Amounts and timestamps
            
- `amountMinor` preserves the signed Log1 amount. Totals describe **filtered movements**, not an account balance.
- `MS2000` / `recordedAtUtc` is the event time, not an insertion watermark. Older postings may arrive days later.
            
### Receipts and retention
            
- `documents` groups this page only; merge further pages by `documentKey`. `items`, offsets and limits remain posting-based.
- Positive DocId groups stay within the same resident, location and period. Missing/invalid IDs and payment-managed lines remain standalone.
- `LawAccountingYears` and `LawSurveillanceDays` come from tenant Log24 with positive manager Log7 overrides.
- Expired identities become the GDPR user KID with empty names/numbers, safe description and `isAnonymized=true`.
- An explicit `userKid` excludes expired entries. Amounts remain in unfiltered bank totals. Zero/missing retention means no identity retention.
- `paymentKind` is Credit, ReserveRefund or Managed, or empty. Payment identifiers are never returned.
- Payment-managed and expired entries cannot use ordinary reversal. No external payment workflow is invoked.
            
### Revisions and refresh
            
- `revision` fingerprints the complete filtered posting set: identities, periods and monetary totals. It is independent of `offset` and `limit`.
- **Compare revisions across pages.** If they differ, discard the accumulated pages and reload them.
- Use `GetBankAccountRevision` for lightweight polling.
- A revision is not a cursor, authorization token or frozen snapshot. Display labels may change independently.
            
### Errors
            
**HTTP 403** keeps code `forbidden`. After tab/resource authorization, the optional `reason` identifies a missing Read permission:
`missing-bank-read`, `missing-location-read`, `missing-unit-read` or `missing-user-read`.
            
**HTTP 503** uses these codes:
            
- `periods-timeout`: period SQL exceeded its **10-second** limit.
- `storage-timeout`: another SQL command timed out.
- `storage-text-comparison`: a collation error occurred.
            
Avoid automatic retry loops.

get.summary: Checks whether filtered Account2 postings changed, including late arrivals with old event timestamps.
get.description:
### Scope and work
            
- Uses the same filters and permissions as `GetBankAccount`. Paging does not affect the revision.
- Runs **one Log1 aggregate**, plus bounded retention-setting reads, without posting rows or label lookups.
- Identical authorized scopes and filters for the same manager share a cache for at most **30 seconds** per API instance. Account and permission checks always run first.
            
### Polling and refresh
            
- Poll no faster than **every 30 seconds**, while the view is visible.
- When the revision changes, reload loaded pages from offset zero. Combine only pages with equal revisions.
- Labels and reversal flags can change independently; this is not a frozen snapshot.

post.summary: Reverses one eligible resident consumption posting by appending a linked compensation.
post.description:
### Access and eligible postings
            
- Requires **Account2**, a **bank-wide grant**, **Bank/User Write** and **Location/Unit Read**.
- Supports recognized consumption with resident IDs and internal tags.
- Payment transfers, anonymous/guest entries, monthly transfers, credits and unknown transaction types are unavailable.
- No external payment provider is called.
            
### Transaction and delivery
            
- An InnoDB transaction locks and revalidates the original posting, rejects repeated reversal with **HTTP 409**, and queues `Log2 SyncUsers`.
- The returned posting is **queued locally**; hardware delivery is not confirmed.
- **Never automatically retry an uncertain write.**

get.summary: Read the object's own address, coordinate pair, provenance and concurrency revision.
get.description:
Send a canonical Bank, Location, Unit or resident User KID from this site; Tenant is excluded.
Requires active manager credentials, an assigned Tab (Users2 for residents), a matching resource grant,
Bank Read and the object's Read permission; Unit also requires Location Read.
Bank and User require bank-wide or tenant-wide grants. Objects and parents must exist and not be deleted.
Disabled locations require a tenant-wide grant. No parent address is inherited.
Latitude and longitude are nullable integer millionths of a degree; 0 is a valid coordinate.
AutoLatitudeLongitude 1..12 is the UTC month of a successful lookup; 30 means manual.
Use revision as expectedRevision in every write. HTTP 404 covers missing and invisible objects.

put.summary: Save Address and Zip together and resolve automatic coordinates once if either field changes.
put.description:
Requires GetObjectAddress access plus the object's Write permission, freshly rechecked inside both transactions.
Example: { "address": "Bjerregade 5", "zip": "8722", "expectedRevision": "revision from GetObjectAddress" }.
Address is limited to 512 characters, zip to 64; both strings are required and may be empty to clear them.
Trims outer whitespace. Unchanged inputs do not call Google. An incomplete address skips coordinate lookup.
Bare zip triggers one postal-city lookup for the trusted site's tenant, also in manual mode:
Team, Nortec and Electrolux use DK (four digits); Washco uses GB (full alphanumeric postcode);
Finelec uses FI (five digits). Other tenants skip postal completion. Clients cannot select the country.
An exact, unambiguous result is appended to zip, for example "7470 Karup J"; existing city text is preserved.
Missing, ambiguous or failed postal results retain the input. This lookup never changes manual coordinates.
When the postal result lacks a city, the full address lookup may supply one with matching postal code and country.
In manual mode this fallback updates Zip only, retaining the coordinate pair and provenance.
There are at most two Google requests: postal completion followed by automatic coordinate lookup; neither is retried.
Existing automatic coordinates are cleared and provenance is set to 0 before the Google request.
Success inserts Latitude, Longitude and the UTC month atomically. Failure leaves automatic coordinates empty.
Manual provenance 30 preserves coordinates and skips coordinate lookup. Concurrent edits supersede the provider result.
HTTP 200 confirms the saved state; inspect outcome for Success, Unchanged, IncompleteAddress,
ManualCoordinatesPreserved, NoResult, TransientFailure, PermanentFailure, NotConfigured or Superseded.
Storage uses bank Log2 (Bank/Location/Unit) or Log7 (User), with Sync=0 and append-only history.
No automatic retries. On 409 reload. After a timeout, lost response or 503, read back before retrying:
the address transaction may already have committed. Provider failure does not undo a saved address.

post.summary: Explicitly look up the current address, replacing manual coordinates only on success.
post.description:
Same access and Write permission as UpdateObjectAddress. Send { "expectedRevision": "current revision" }.
One Google request at most. Automatic coordinates are cleared first; manual coordinates survive failure.
For a Location whose Address is blank, use its own Name plus Zip as the lookup input.
Only a successful result inserts Name into Address together with the coordinate pair and UTC month.
Name-based failures preserve the prior values; missing/invalid Name or Zip returns IncompleteAddress.
A concurrent rename supersedes the name-based result, just like a concurrent address edit.
A concurrent edit returns Superseded without overwriting the newer values. Outcome and errors follow UpdateObjectAddress.
This is the deliberate retry operation for an unchanged address; no background retry is scheduled.

put.summary: Save manual Latitude and Longitude atomically with AutoLatitudeLongitude=30.
put.description:
Same access and Write permission as UpdateObjectAddress. Send integer millionths of degrees, never decimal degrees.
Example: { "latitude": 55771181, "longitude": 9697176, "expectedRevision": "current revision" }.
Latitude range is -90000000..90000000; longitude -180000000..180000000. Both are required.
Manual coordinates survive future address edits. LookupObjectCoordinates can deliberately replace them.
Returns ManualCoordinatesSaved on success. Errors and read-back advice follow UpdateObjectAddress.

put.summary: Change AutoLatitudeLongitude without changing the coordinate pair or making a Google request.
put.description:
Same access and Write permission as UpdateObjectAddress. Send value and expectedRevision.
Supported values: 0 (unknown), 1..12 (successful lookup month), 13 (legacy pending), 20 (legacy failed), 30 (manual).
Values 1..12 require an existing valid coordinate pair. Manual (30) is allowed before coordinates exist.
Selecting 13 does not call Google or enqueue a retry.
Only 30 protects coordinates against automatic lookup on subsequent address changes.
Example: { "value": 30, "expectedRevision": "current revision" }. Returns ProvenanceSaved.

post.summary: Ask the portal assistant to discover and combine approved read operations.
post.description:
Sends the question, supplied visible history and relevant authorized API results to OpenAI.
With Logz.io shipping enabled, the current question text is logged once after session revalidation,
before model use. History, answers and bearer credentials are not included in this log event.
Requires server-side configuration. The current manager session is revalidated before model use;
each business read independently enforces its existing Tab/KID/Read permissions. No special agent rights.
question: 1–2000 characters. history: at most 12 user/assistant messages, 8000 characters each,
20000 total. History is untrusted context; no server-side conversation is retained. Accept-Language selects
the default answer language. Response answer is plain text. operations lists attempted business reads;
links contains up to 20 bank/location links derived from successful authorized results.
Each link includes kid/path, optional name, canonical parent bankKid and ready-to-render iconKid.
The portal uses this metadata to add the clicked object to the local workspace; access is rechecked on navigation.
At most 8 reads, pages capped at 50, 48000 bytes per result and 120 seconds per question.
Available reads: SearchBanks, SearchLocations, SearchUsers, GetSearchBank, GetBankLocations,
GetLocations, GetLocationUnits, GetTenantStatus. Missing access, partial sources and truncation must not
be interpreted as empty/healthy data. Generated answers can be wrong; verify the underlying records.
Reviewed AGENTS.md instructions and three named skills are packaged with the API. Skill loading uses
the same model-turn budget and grants no extra permissions. The balance skill explains that balance
and account-transaction reads are not currently in the approved chat catalogue.
400 invalid input; 401 invalid/revoked session; 403 session denied; 429 six questions/minute per manager
or global capacity exhausted; 503 assistant-not-configured/provider unavailable/deadline. Assistant
failures have a code extension; middleware authentication, validation and throttling retain their normal
error format. No automatic retries. Responses application-state storage is disabled with store=false.

get.summary: Search WashDoc document identities by location, unit and time without loading measurements.
get.description:
### Access
Active manager bearer, at least one of WashDoc1/2/3, Location Read and Unit Read, and a matching resource grant.
Location-only grants and RetentionDays restrict both results and filter choices before paging. KIDs must be canonical and site-bound.
### Filters and ordering
Optional locationKid and unitKid must belong to the requested bank; unitKid also selects its location.
from/through are inclusive ISO 8601 timestamps with an explicit UTC offset (default: last 24 hours, maximum: 31 days).
A document matches when a tagged Cycle setting occurs inside that interval. lastActivityUtc is its latest matching Cycle timestamp,
not necessarily the document's start or end. Open its table for the complete interval and completion status.
Newest matching activity first, then location/unit/document identity. limit 1–100 (default 25), offset 0–100000, hasMore indicates another page.
No total count or measurement queries. Live changes can shift offset pages; reset offset to refresh the list.
### Limits and errors
At most 1000 visible locations, 5000 visible/discoverable units and 35000 unit-setting rows per search; narrow by location on 422.
400 invalid filters, 401 inactive session, 403 missing access, 404 hidden/missing filter object, 422 oversized scope, 503 storage unavailable/busy.
Twelve-second storage deadline; no response cache. Filter choices include only currently visible units with Log24 metadata.

get.summary: Resolve up to eight bank icons with their authorized units' combined status.
get.description:
Repeat kid with canonical bank KIDs from this site. Requires an active manager, assigned Tab,
Bank Read, Location Read, Unit Read and a matching resource grant. A location-only grant includes only that location.
Location and unit RetentionDays visibility applies; disabled locations require access to all banks.
Any included Alive.Offline=1 sets offline=true and Kid.Icons[1]=eIcon.error. A nonempty set entirely
known Offline=0 sets offline=false and eIcon.check. Empty/incomplete status is null unless some unit is offline.
Units are discovered in Log24; orphan Alive rows do not contribute. No writes.
Per-item 403/503 returns no icon/status; 400 invalid/foreign/oversized input, 401 expired session, 503 session storage failure.
The API returns opaque iconKid, preserving primary icon and bank number text. Use it unchanged with GetIconFromSet.
Read visible banks only, deduplicate and refresh at most every ten seconds, pausing hidden pages.
Status is cached ten seconds per authorized location set, location/label metadata sixty seconds. HTTP is no-store.
Bounded to 65,536 units per bank and 128 locations per SQL batch; oversized or ambiguous data fails, never partial online.

get.summary: List location names, icons, status and canonical KIDs in bank overview order (location number).
get.description:
### Access and visibility
            
- Requires an active manager, at least one assigned **Tab**, **Location Read** and a matching site/bank/location grant.
- Location-only managers see only their granted locations.
- An explicit site-wide grant lists all location states, including disabled locations and deletions outside RetentionDays.
- Other grants require Enabled exactly 1 and deletion within **RetentionDays**. Missing Deleted means zero;
  zero retention hides all deleted locations, and malformed/future deletions are hidden.
            
### Results and cache
            
- Returns names, icons, enabled, deleted, deletedAt and canonical KIDs in **location-number order**.
- Enabled is true only for stored Enabled exactly 1; missing or invalid values mean false.
- Deleted indicates a positive Deleted MS2000 value; deletedAt is its UTC timestamp (null for zero or an unrepresentable value).
- For status display, disabled takes precedence over deleted, then active. Status never grants access.
- Locations lacking all Name, Icon, Deleted and Enabled settings cannot be discovered. Missing or invalid icons use `house`.
- One bank-scoped query is cached for **60 seconds**; authorization is checked on every request.
- No pagination or total-count query.

get.summary: Search current bank names and settlement emails; literal case-insensitive substring matching.
get.description:
### Access and identifiers
            
- Requires at least one current **Tab**, **Bank Read** and a matching grant. A location grant allows discovery of its parent bank only.
- Only **BankId ≥ 1000** is searchable.
- Accepts an exact canonical or readable KID. An omitted tenant is resolved from trusted site configuration; `matchedSetting` is `Kid`.
- Cross-tenant or inaccessible identities return no results.
            
### Text search and results
            
- Searches current bank **Name** and **SettlementEmails** using literal, case-insensitive substrings.
- `q`: **2–128 trimmed characters**. At most **50 rows**; `hasMore` asks the caller to refine the query.
- Current Name, Icon and SettlementEmails settings come from **Log24**, supporting JSON and legacy text.
- Uses a **60-second scoped cache**.

get.summary: Decode a bank activation code and resolve its name and icon from the cached Log24 bank catalogue.
get.description:
### Access and lookup
            
- Uses the same authorization as `SearchBanks`. Only bank codes for this site's tenant and granted banks match.
- Invalid or out-of-scope codes skip the bank lookup. Missing banks return an empty list.
- Resolves name and icon from the cached **Log24 bank catalogue**; `zip` remains empty.
            
### Shared activation-code rate limit
            
- Maximum **5 requests per 10 minutes** and **20 per hour**, per manager in this tenant API process, across tokens and IP addresses.
- The bank, location and resident activation-code endpoints share this quota. **All attempts count**, including malformed and successful codes.
- **HTTP 429** includes `Retry-After` in seconds. Do not retry early.

get.summary: Resolve a search result before opening its bank overview, including tenant-wide managers.
get.description:
### Access and lookup
            
- Resolves one canonical bank KID on this site before opening the bank overview, including for tenant-wide managers.
- Requires the same active session, current Tab, **Bank Read** and matching grant as `SearchBanks`.
- Only **BankId ≥ 1000** is discoverable. A stored search result is not an access grant.
            
### Result
            
- Returns the matching bank from the scoped catalogue, or empty items when absent or inaccessible.
- Invalid or cross-tenant bank KIDs return **HTTP 400**.

get.summary: Read one page of users for a bank.
get.description:
### Access and visibility
            
- Requires **Users2 (53)**, **User Read** and a matching tenant/bank/location grant.
- Location-only grants include **Access** and **NoAccess** associations; other locations are removed from the response.
- Ordinary users only, including `eUserId.UsersLast`. Deleted users follow **RetentionDays**.
- `email` is the current Log7 `eSetting.Email` (2800), decoded from JSON or legacy plain text.
- `sms` is the current Log7 `eSetting.SMS` number, decoded without changing its format. Missing email/SMS values are empty.
            
### Paging
            
- `pageSize`: **1–100**, default **25**. Copy `previousCursor` or `nextCursor` unchanged into `cursor`.
- Cursors are shareable positions, not credentials.
- Keep filters, sort and direction unchanged while using a cursor. Restart **without a cursor** when changing them.
            
### Ordering
            
- `sort`: `identity` (legacy default, ascending only), `number`, `name`, `location` or `deleted`.
- `direction`: `asc` or `desc`. User identity breaks ties.
- Number orders numeric values before text. Text comparison is ordinal and case-insensitive.
- Location uses the lowest permitted Access/NoAccess location. Missing values and not-deleted users sort first in ascending order.
- Sorted mode uses a **four-setting index cached for one minute** and reads details only for the selected page.
            
### Text and identity filters
            
- `filter`: optional case-insensitive substring in **Number OR Name**, at most **200 characters**, with surrounding whitespace trimmed.
- Wildcards: `*` matches zero or more characters; `?` matches one. Other symbols are literal.
- Filtering precedes paging and uses the shared sorting index.
- `userKid` selects exactly one ordinary bank user and cannot be combined with `filter` or `cursor`.
- The same Tab, scope, operation and retention checks apply. Missing or inaccessible users return empty items.
            
### Location and deletion filters
            
- `locationKid` filters an authorized location in the same bank, including Access and NoAccess associations.
- `deleted`: `all` (default), `active`, `deleted` or `no-access`.
- `no-access` means no recorded Access in any manager-visible location. Empty lists and NoAccess-only lists match; hidden locations do not affect the result.
- Existing visibility and deletion retention still apply. `locationKid` remains an additional association filter.
            
### Cache and scan limits
            
- Every request rechecks access. Data may be cached for **60 seconds**. No total count is queried.
- Legacy identity mode examines at most **1,000 candidates**. `scanLimitReached` may accompany an empty or short page; follow `nextCursor` to continue.
- Concurrent changes are not a transactionally frozen snapshot.

post.summary: Create a resident. Requires bank-wide Users2/User Create. Action must be create. No hardware access is assigned automatically.
post.description:
### Access and request
            
- Requires an active manager, **Users2**, **User Read**, **User Create** and a **bank-wide grant**.
- `action` must be `create`. The canonical bank KID must belong to this site.
- No hardware access is assigned automatically.
            
### Result and synchronization
            
- **HTTP 201:** returns authoritative resident workspace details and a revision.
- Successful creation schedules the existing backend synchronization; it is not instant hardware confirmation.
- Resident data and synchronization use Log tables exclusively. No notification or billing operation is executed.
- Disabled, unconfigured or nontransactional storage returns **HTTP 503**.

get.summary: Lists the latest nonsuperseded Log5 event for each location/unit/resident/start.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires **Bookings1**, **Location/Unit/User Read** and matching bank or location grants.
- Denial reads no booking data. **HTTP 403** keeps code `forbidden`; after tab/resource authorization, optional `reason` identifies `missing-location-read`, `missing-unit-read` or `missing-user-read`.
            
### Dates and events
            
- Inclusive local date range, defaulting to UTC today minus **7 days** through plus **90 days**; maximum **367 dates**.
- Weekly positions (**0–10,079**) are returned separately, never converted to UTC. `recordedAtUtc` is the event time.
- AUT/isy events are excluded as in Bookings1. Filters and pagination run after selecting the latest event.
            
### Search and paging
            
- Search matches stored resident name/number. Only authorized location/unit filter labels are returned.
- `limit`: **1–200**, default **50**. `offset`: **0–100,000**.
- Stable start/location/unit/user order. No total-count query or cache.

post.summary: Appends a cancellation or restoration, preserving history and requesting backend synchronization.
post.description:
### Command and access
            
- `action` is `cancel` or `restore`.
- Requires **Bookings1**, **Location/User Read**, **Unit Write** and the event's location grant.
- The booking KID identifies the **exact event reviewed** by the caller. Stale or repeated commands return **HTTP 409**.
            
### Transaction and restoration
            
- Current events are locked and rechecked in one **InnoDB transaction**. Do not retry automatically.
- Restoration rejects overlapping active reservations.
- Weekly restorations are unsupported. Active weekly schedules conservatively block restoration on their unit.
- `sync=false` means **queued**, not confirmed by the controller.

get.summary: Downloads the complete filtered selection as CSV or a genuine Excel workbook.

### Scope and limits
            
- Uses the same permissions and filters as `GetBankAccount`. Pagination is ignored.
- Maximum **10,000 rows** and **4 million description characters**.
- Oversized selections fail with **HTTP 413**, `data-limit`, instead of returning a truncated file.
            
### File contents
            
- Downloads CSV or a genuine Excel workbook; spreadsheet formulas are neutralized.
- Money uses signed minor units; dates use **UTC**.
- The same retention rules, user filtering and safe descriptions as GetBankAccount apply; column names are unchanged.
- Headers and identifiers are stable and language-independent.

get.summary: Download filtered residents as UTF-8 CSV, at most 10,000 residents and 4 MiB text.
get.description:
### Access and selection
            
- Uses the same **Users2/User Read**, scope, retention and filter rules as `GetBankUsers`. Authorization is rechecked for every page.
- `deleted` accepts `all`, `active`, `deleted` and `no-access`.
- `no-access` excludes users with recorded Access in any manager-visible location.
- Export is not a transactionally frozen snapshot.
            
### Format and limits
            
- **UTF-8 CSV**, semicolon delimiter, stable English column identifiers and ISO UTC dates.
- Cells are quoted and protected against spreadsheet formulas.
- At most **10,000 residents** and **4 MiB text**.
- A limit failure returns **HTTP 422** without a partial file; narrow the filter.

get.summary: Downloads a ZIP with one settlement file per group and currency, plus a reconciliation manifest.
get.description:
### Download contents
            
- Returns a ZIP with **one settlement file per group and currency**, plus a reconciliation manifest.
- This operation never closes or changes a period.
            
### Formats
            
The `format` value is **case-sensitive**:
            
- `XLS` — produces real **XLSX** files.
- `ATB`, `BL`, `DEAS`, `FRUEHØJGAARD`, `HEIMSTADEN`, `LEJERBO`.
- `MD90_1`, `MD90_3`, `MD90_3_minus`, `MD90_3_plus`, `MD90_3_AABKBH`.
- `NAVISION`.
            
### Restrictions
            
- `MD90_3` supports banks **1001 and 1068 only**.
- `NIRAS` and `ROBERT` are obsolete.
- Invalid or oversized source data fails explicitly.

get.summary: Download a UTF-8 CSV table for one document.

get.summary: Read recent DigitalOcean runtime logs for a configured shared app.
get.description:
Requires Logs1, Managers Read and whole-tenant access. Operator policy explicitly permits
cross-tenant app logs for managers with this access. Logs can contain other customers.
environment: beta/production; application: portal-api/equipment-api/portal-web. No MySQL logs.
Returns up to 100 plain-text lines, a fetchedAtUtc snapshot timestamp and a truncated flag.
Poll at most every 10 seconds. This is a recent snapshot, not a durable or complete log history.
400 invalid selection; 401 invalid session; 403 missing Tab, Read or tenant grant;
503 hosting-not-configured or hosting-unavailable. Failed reads never return stale logs.
Provider tokens, signed URLs and raw transport errors are never returned. Render lines as text.
Runtime logs only; build, deploy, crash and database logs are not provided by this operation.
When continuous forwarding is enabled on the collector host, reads use its bounded runtime buffer.
Logz.io delivery runs independently of readers; this response does not confirm remote delivery.

get.summary: Read hosting metrics for one configured application or Managed MySQL cluster.
get.description:
Requires an active manager, Hosting1 (81), Managers Read and a whole-tenant KID grant for this site.
Every request rechecks the bounded manager snapshot (at most 60 seconds old), before any metric cache hit.
Infrastructure is shared: values cover all customers in the app, not this tenant's individual usage.
environment is beta or production; application is portal-api, equipment-api, portal-web or mysql; hours is 1, 6 or 24.
These fixed selectors never accept tenant IDs, provider app IDs or URLs. The site owns all provider mappings.
Metrics cpu/memory use percent; restarts use the provider's count series, not a calculated window total.
Series retain component/instance separation. Null samples are gaps; empty series mean no data, never zero.
bandwidth.dateUtc is yesterday in UTC, independent of hours; bytes is an unsigned decimal string or null.
For mysql, metrics are cpu/memory/disk (provider cluster averages in percent) and connections (current threads,
count). Bandwidth is null. The same database may be shared by beta and production. No SQL is executed.
Check every errorCode: a partial response is HTTP 200 with hosting-source-unavailable for failed sources.
All sources failing returns 503 hosting-unavailable; disabled/missing configuration returns 503 hosting-not-configured.
Results and failures are cached for 60 seconds on the API; refresh no faster than refreshAfterSeconds.
FetchedAtUtc identifies the snapshot, not the latest sample. Sample timestamps may lag or be absent.
400 invalid-hosting-selection; 401 revoked/invalid session; 403 missing-hosting-tab,
missing-managers-read or missing-tenant-access. No secrets or provider error bodies are returned.
Browser responses are no-store. See the integration guide's Hosting section for copyable examples.

post.summary: Save an installer's selected Person icon.
post.description:
### Access and validation
- Requires active manager, Installers1 (68), independent Installer Read and Write and whole-tenant access.
- Rechecks the current locked manager account, credential stamp, tabs, rights and scope, and target existence
  and caller RetentionDays, inside the write transaction. Manager Write alone grants nothing here.
- installerKid must be canonical, from this site, with BankId=TenantId and eUserId.Installeres..InstalleresLast.
- Send an exact eIcon name with eIconSubject.Person metadata and expectedRevision from GetInstaller.
  Current non-Person icons may be displayed but cannot be assigned. Do not post clicks on an already selected legacy icon.
            
### Storage and response
- Appends only eSetting.Icon to A{TenantId:D4}{TenantId:D5}.Log7 with the acting manager in TagId and database
  MS2000. Verifies the trigger's A{TenantId:D4}.Log7 current value at BankId=TenantId before committing.
- Serializable transaction; unchanged raw values add no history. No other installer settings or Alive change.
- Update the icon and workspace only after a complete 200 response. Use its iconRevision for the next edit.
- Directory indexes are invalidated locally even after uncertain outcomes; other instances may retain list
  indexes for up to 60 seconds. Details are always fresh. All responses are no-store, with a 12-second deadline.
            
### Errors
- 400 invalid-installer-kid/invalid-installer-icon; 401 revoked session; 403 missing-installers-tab,
  missing-installers-read, missing-installers-write or missing-tenant-access; 404 installer-not-found.
- 409 installer-icon-conflict: reread and review before another save. Revision covers the raw Icon value and row presence.
- 503 installer-icon-unavailable: keep the displayed icon and reread before retrying manually. A lost response
  can follow commit; never retry a mutation automatically. Database writes must be configured for the site.

get.summary: List installers with locations, tags, account state and last activity.
get.description:
### Access and storage
            
- Requires an active manager, Installers1 (68), PermissionInstaller2 Read and a whole-tenant KID grant.
- Bank/location-only grants and Write without Read are insufficient. Current account, credential stamp,
  tab, permission and tenant scope are checked on every page through the bounded 60-second snapshot.
- Reads only A{TenantId:D4}.Log7, BankId=TenantId and eUserId.Installeres through InstalleresLast (1–999).
  Tenant comes exclusively from trusted site configuration. Passwords and activation secrets are never selected.
            
### Returned data
            
- Object identifiers are canonical KIDs. Derive the displayed UserId from the installer KID.
- Locations and tags use the same JSON/legacy decoding as residents. State is retained, including NoAccess
  and locked/deleted/history tags. These are metadata, never additional permissions for the caller.
- Disabled installers remain visible. Deleted installers follow the caller's RetentionDays; malformed/future
  deletion values are hidden. LastActiveAt is the Alive row's MS2000 converted to UTC, never its Text value.
- Missing/invalid Enabled and activity are null; missing Deleted is zero. Reads do not update activity.
            
### Paging, filtering and ordering
            
- pageSize is 1–100 (default 50). Follow nextCursor until null; a page may be empty due to retention.
- filter is a literal, case-insensitive Name/Email substring, at most 128 characters. Wildcards are escaped.
- Sorts: identity, name, email, locations, tags, deleted, enabled, lastActive; direction asc or desc.
- Sort applies before paging. Text is ordinal case-insensitive; location/tag lists compare sorted numeric
  IDs and then states lexicographically, not their displayed text or count. Identity breaks ties in the same direction.
- Null values sort first ascending, last descending. Deleted sorts by timestamp, Enabled by null/false/true.
- Identity ascending uses bounded keyset reads. Other sorts use a tenant-local index, at most 999 identities,
  cached for 60 seconds, then fresh page details with retention reapplied. No per-installer queries.
- Cursors are bound to caller, tenant, filter, ordering and page size. Restart without a cursor when any changes.
  Concurrent updates are not a frozen snapshot; a removed cursor anchor requires restarting.
            
### Errors and limits
            
- 400: invalid-page, invalid-filter, invalid-sort or invalid-cursor. 401: invalid/revoked session.
- 403: missing-installers-tab, missing-installers-read or missing-tenant-access.
- 503 installers-unavailable: database unavailable or the 12-second deadline elapsed; no partial sorted result.
  Retry manually. All responses are no-store. No installer writes are provided by this operation.

get.summary: Read one installer and the same Person icon catalog used for administrators.
get.description:
Requires active manager, Installers1, Installer Read and whole-tenant access, exactly as GetInstallers.
The canonical KID must use this site's tenant, BankId=TenantId, installer type and the installer UserId range.
Returns 404 installer-not-found for absent or retention-hidden records. Disabled installers remain visible.
AvailableIcons contains every eIcon with eIconSubject.Person metadata. A safe current non-Person icon
appears first for display only. CanEditIcon additionally requires independent Installer Write.
Read IconRevision before SetInstallerIcon; metadata and edit hints never grant authorization.
No-store; 12-second deadline; 400 invalid-installer-kid, 401/403 as for the list, 503 installers-unavailable.

get.summary: Read recent live logs from Portal API, Equipment API and Portal Web.
get.description:
Requires Logs1, Managers Read and a whole-tenant grant. Every read rechecks the bounded
manager snapshot before source/cache access. No tenant, server URL or arbitrary query is accepted.
Each server retains at most 100 sanitized events for 15 minutes in memory; restart clears history.
Application Information and all Warning-or-higher events are captured. This is neither Logz.io history nor a durable audit trail.
Poll no faster than refreshAfterSeconds (3). Server errors are independent: check each errorCode.
live-logs-not-configured means disabled/missing settings; live-logs-unavailable means a source failed
or its tenant/role did not match. Empty successful cards mean no recent events on that instance.
BankId/UserIds are requested, authorized diagnostic IDs, scoped by tenantKid; no balance values appear.
401 revoked/invalid session; 403 missing-logs-tab, missing-managers-read or missing-tenant-access;
503 live-logs-unavailable for unavailable authorization storage. Browser responses are no-store.
Multiple replicas have separate buffers; this endpoint does not aggregate all replicas.

get.summary: Count accessible active locations for the Banks2 navigation icon.
get.description:
Requires an active manager, Banks2 (5), Bank Read, Location Read and current site/bank/location grants.
Counts distinct Log24 locations (BankId at least 1000) with Enabled exactly 1 and Deleted zero;
missing Deleted means zero, missing/invalid Enabled or malformed Deleted are excluded.
These state rules also apply to all-bank managers. For limited grants the parent bank must remain
visible under RetentionDays. No search, paging or client-selected scope is accepted.
Returns count and a ready-to-render iconKid containing Kid.Count. The aggregate is read afresh on each request; permission snapshots live at most 60 seconds.
401: invalid/revoked session. 403: missing-banks-tab, missing-bank-read, missing-location-read or missing-resource-access.
503 locations-unavailable: storage unavailable or the 12-second deadline elapsed; retry manually. No-store.

get.summary: List accessible locations with parent banks, Visma customer numbers and authorized activation codes.
get.description:
### Authorization and data
Requires an active manager, Banks2 (5), Bank Read, Location Read and site/bank/location grants.
Every page rechecks the current bounded manager snapshot. Location-only grants never reveal sibling locations.
Reads only the site's Log24; BankId must be at least 1000. Discovery requires Name, Icon, VismaCustNo, Enabled or Deleted.
An explicit site-wide grant lists all states, including disabled locations and deletions outside RetentionDays.
Limited grants require the location's Enabled value to be exactly 1 (missing/other values are hidden).
For limited grants, both bank and location deletion follow RetentionDays: zero or an inclusive window ending now;
missing Deleted means zero, malformed/future values are hidden. All filtering precedes paging.
Enabled is true only for stored 1. Deleted is null when malformed, otherwise indicates a positive MS2000 value.
DeletedAt is the corresponding UTC timestamp, or null for zero, invalid or unrepresentable values.
BankKid and Kid are canonical identifiers. Missing names/VismaCustNo are empty, invalid icons use bank_building/house.
HasAllBanksAccess indicates an explicit site-wide grant. Both activation codes require this grant;
BankActivationCode additionally requires Bank Create and LocationActivationCode requires Location Create.
Otherwise the code is null. A displayed code never grants API permission.
            
### Optional columns
fields: comma-separated vismaCustNo, bankActivationCode, locationActivationCode, address, zip, longitude, latitude,
teltonikaSms, alternativeBankName, mask, timeZone, online, lastContactAt.
Text filtering also searches all selected stored columns before pagination; unselected extra columns do not match.
Decimal coordinates and gift amounts accept dot/comma; date searches accept ISO or dd.MM.yyyy/dd-MM-yyyy, UTC for contacts.
bankName is an optional selection marker for showing the bank name and bank icon together after the location in the portal. Core bank identity properties remain populated.
Billing fields (also accepted as sort keys): vismaCrAcNo, vismaInvoiceVersion, vismaOrdre, vismaPNTurnover, vismaPNSettlement, vismaSettlement, vismaVAT, vismaServiceKey, vismaStart, vismaNote, hiddenNote, vismaGuaranteeMonth, vismaGuaranteeUnder, vismaGuarantee, vismaGuaranteeCustomer, vismaGuaranteeOver, gift, giftBegin, giftEnd, giftSplit, giftPN.
GiftPN uses legacy location setting 1620 (the shared enum calls this identity DurationIsETA for units).
Billing fields return location-owned stored text; omitted fields are null, selected missing fields are empty.
TeltonikaSms, alternativeBankName, mask and timeZone are location-owned TeltonikaSMS, Bank, Access and TimeZone settings, returned as stored text without inheritance.
Missing selected text is empty; unselected text is null. Preserve mask syntax, phone prefixes and legacy time-zone codes (100 means UTC+1).
Omitted/empty means core identifiers, status, names and icons only; unselected properties are null.
Address and Zip are location-owned settings without bank fallback. Coordinates are decimal degrees (stored microdegrees / 1,000,000), null when missing/invalid.
Only selected settings are joined, plus the sort setting and VismaCustNo when required for search. Codes retain all scope/Create checks.
includeCoordinates=true additionally returns latitude/longitude for map presentation without adding them to text search.
Defaults to false; keep it unchanged across cursor requests. Authorization and coordinate null/degree rules are unchanged.
The response fields array names the requested columns. Keep fields unchanged across cursor requests; order and duplicates do not matter.
            
Online and LastContactAt read the tenant-bound Alive table only when selected or sorted, for Log24-discovered visible main units (Alive.UnitId = Alive.MainId).
Online is false if any is offline, true only for a nonempty entirely known-online set, otherwise null.
LastContactAt is the latest MS2000 in (0,now], returned as UTC ISO 8601; absent/invalid contacts are null.
It means last contact, not last machine run. Deleted units follow RetentionDays; orphan Alive rows do not contribute.
            
### Search, sorting and paging
pageSize: 1–100, default 50. filter: at most 128 characters, literal case/accent-insensitive substring of bank name,
location name or VismaCustNo. Exact canonical/readable/site-relative bank and location KIDs are supported.
Complete bank/location activation codes match only when the caller could view that code; bank codes include tenant,
location codes use the trusted site tenant. No cross-tenant reads. Empty filter lists all accessible locations.
sort: name (default), bankName, vismaCustNo, address, zip, longitude, latitude, teltonikaSms,
alternativeBankName, mask, timeZone, online, lastContactAt, bankActivationCode or locationActivationCode;
direction: asc (default) or desc. MySQL utf8mb4_general_ci
text ordering precedes LIMIT. Coordinates (validated microdegrees) and legacy timeZone sort numerically;
Online sorts unknown/offline/online; lastContactAt sorts chronologically; missing/invalid numeric values sort first ascending and last descending. Gift, giftBegin and giftEnd also sort numerically; other settings sort as text.
Codes sort numerically using FlexActivation: stream authorized matching rows and retain at most pageSize+1 candidates.
Code sorts may take longer on large result sets; narrow filter when needed. No full catalogue is retained in memory.
Sorting codes requires permission to see that code (otherwise 403 missing-code-access).
Numeric bank/location identities break ties in the same direction for every sort.
Follow nextCursor until null; cursors are protected, expire after 15 minutes and are bound to tenant, manager,
resource grants, retention, filter, enabledOnly, sort, direction and page size. Restart without a cursor when these change.
enabledOnly: false by default. When true, exclude locations whose Enabled is not exactly 1 before paging.
This narrows the authorized view only; deletion/retention rules and activation-code permissions remain unchanged.
Concurrent edits are not a frozen snapshot; renamed rows may move. No count or full catalogue is returned.
            
### Errors
400: invalid-page, invalid-filter, invalid-sort, invalid-fields, invalid-cursor. 401: invalid/revoked session.
403: missing-banks-tab, missing-bank-read, missing-location-read, missing-resource-access, missing-code-access.
503 locations-unavailable: storage unavailable or the 12-second deadline elapsed. Retry manually. No-store.

get.summary: Search location Name, Bank (alternative bank name), Zip, Address, VismaCustNo and TeltonikaSMS in Log24.
get.description:
### Access and identifiers
            
- Requires a current **Tab**, **Location Read**, site-bound resource grants and **RetentionDays** visibility.
- Only **BankId ≥ 1000** is searchable.
- Accepts exact canonical or readable KIDs. An omitted tenant comes from trusted site configuration; `matchedSetting` is `Kid`.
- Cross-tenant or inaccessible identities return no results.
            
### Text search
            
- Searches **Name**, **Bank** (alternative bank name), **Zip**, **Address**, **VismaCustNo** and **TeltonikaSMS** in Log24.
- Literal, case-insensitive substring matching; **2–128 trimmed characters**.
- Returns `matchedSetting` and `matchedValue`; Name has first priority.
- A separate **60-second cache** coalesces requests.
            
### Results and parent banks
            
- At most **50 matching locations**. `hasMore` counts locations.
- When Bank Read is granted, includes distinct parent banks with `isContext=true`.
- Parent bank context contains only name/icon, never contact fields.
- **Merge all items by KID.**

get.summary: Decode a location activation code and resolve its visible name and icon in Log24.
get.description:
### Access and lookup
            
- Uses the same authorization as `SearchLocations`.
- Codes contain bank/location, not tenant; the **trusted site supplies the tenant**.
- Invalid, missing or inaccessible locations return no items. No other tenant is queried.
- Resolves the visible name and icon in **Log24**.
            
### Shared activation-code rate limit
            
- The bank, location and resident code endpoints share **5 calls per 10 minutes** and **20 per hour**, per manager.
- Invalid calls count toward the quota.
- **HTTP 429** includes `Retry-After`; wait before trying again.

get.summary: Read localized configured reservation rules for the location's visible units.
get.description:
Requires an active manager, an assigned Tab, Location Read, Unit Read, matching site/KID scope and
RetentionDays visibility, identical to GetLocationUnits. Authorization precedes the bounded Log24 read.
The trusted site selects the tenant. Only visible units may contribute settings or dependency names.
Units are grouped by their full calendar AND rule settings. Different policies in one calendar receive
SettingsConflict; presentation groups do not create separate quotas. This is configuration, not a
resident-specific permission, real-time availability check or booking validation.
            
Response: locationKid, calculatedAt (UTC), groups [{name?, units [{kid,name}], rules [{code,text,warning,parts}]}].
Groups provide the compact API presentation: identical visible rules are combined;
shared rules appear once with common=true and localized name/help, followed by differing rules per unit group.
Each group includes units and rules. Reservation quota scopes remain separate.
Each optional parts array contains ordered {text,isValue} objects. Concatenating their text without separators
reproduces the unchanged rule text. isValue identifies values that clients may emphasize. If parts is absent
or empty, use rule.text. All text is plain text, never HTML; markup-like stored values must be escaped by clients.
Accept-Language localizes names and text, including value placement; codes remain stable.
Currency comes from registered settings, never the UI language; unknown currency is explicit.
V3 calendars are supported; malformed calendars return InvalidCalendar. Missing calendars are omitted,
except instant reservation. Missing legacy settings use their legacy defaults; malformed values produce
UnknownSettings. A zero week limit describes the legacy 400-day horizon; positive limits include this week.
Before/after/add-time default to 15 minutes; drying-room search defaults to 4320 minutes.
No user bookings are loaded and no reservation or maintenance action is performed.
            
At most 255 units / 8192 values, eight seconds total and two concurrent settings reads. No Alive reads
for rule data. 400 invalid KID/site; 401 expired/inactive session; 403 missing scope/tab/read permission;
404 missing/retention-hidden location; 503 busy/unavailable/invalid/oversized storage. Never treat 503 as
unrestricted booking. Empty groups means no visible configured booking calendar.

get.summary: Get the location label and its units, ordered by unit number.
get.description:
### Access and visibility
            
- Requires an active manager, at least one assigned **Tab**, **Location Read**, **Unit Read** and matching tenant/bank/location access.
- Send a canonical location KID on this site.
- Location and unit deletion both follow **RetentionDays**; missing Deleted means zero.
- Current unit settings, Cycle, Enabled, OutOfOrder, WashDocId, Connected, Started and Done come from **Log24**, in one bounded query.
            
### Names, icons and cycle
            
- Missing or invalid unit icons use `object_cube`; explicitly configured icons are preserved.
- The API adds the unit number to `iconKid.Text`. The `g/object_cube` asset prints it on the box face.
- Unit names resolve `[eLocalization numeric ID]` placeholders using `Accept-Language` on each request, defaulting to `en-GB`. Unknown IDs remain unchanged.
- Cycle uses the newest MS2000 from `eSetting.Cycle` or `eState.Cycle`; state wins ties.
- Absent or invalid cycle values return null. `cycle` is an enum name; `cycleText` is its localized label.
- `unitType` is the effective numeric type; `unitTypeName` is the eUnitType name when defined; `unitTypeSource` identifies the source setting.
- A present UnitType2 takes precedence, including when malformed (null type, no legacy fallback). Otherwise UnitType is decoded using FlexOrm's `(value >> 1) & 63` rule.
- Missing/invalid types return null, never an invented Type000. Unknown numeric types are retained without claiming metadata support.
- `progress` contains `status`, nullable `percent`/`remainingSeconds` and `calculatedAtUtc`. The API recalculates from Started/Done at request time; clients need no MS2000 or KID calculations.
- `Estimated` is 0–99%; `Complete` is 100% only for the actual DONE phase (excluding LinkOnline). Cycle substeps are not percentages. Disabled/out-of-order/disconnected/error states suppress estimates.
- `UnknownEndTime` covers missing/reset/invalid times, the unknown-end sentinel, mismatched sequence DocIds and fractional Connected quality. `EstimateExpired` means wait for the actual cycle; it never means complete. Both have null percentages and remaining time.
- Enabled must be exactly 1. Connected=0 blocks estimates; missing Connected is not assumed offline. Started/Done are JSON Text values; TagId is the sequence. No user identities are read for progress.
            
### Results and cache
            
- At most **255 units**, ordered by unit number. No paging or count query.
- No visible units returns empty items.
- Unit data is cached for up to **10 seconds** and location labels for up to **60 seconds**. Authorization is reapplied on every call.
            
### Errors
            
- **HTTP 404:** missing or invisible location.
- After tab/resource checks, **HTTP 403** may include `reason` of `missing-location-read` or `missing-unit-read`. No business storage is read on denial.

get.summary: Read an authorized unit and its type's setting/state groups.
get.description:
### Access
- Requires an active manager, at least one assigned Tab, Location Read, Unit Read and a matching tenant/bank/location grant.
- Send a canonical unit KID on this site. The unit and its parent location must be visible within RetentionDays.
- Uses the same bounded, ten-second location snapshot as GetLocationUnits. Authorization is reapplied on every call, before metadata is exposed.
### Result
- Returns `location`, `unit`, `descriptorAvailable`, `settingGroups` and `stateGroups`.
- Group identifiers are stable eSettingGroup/eStateGroup names, deduplicated and ordered by numeric enum value.
- Metadata comes from the installed Kombine.Flex.Units descriptor packages, selected by the unit's effective type; no runtime/hardware connection is made.
- Missing, malformed or unsupported types return descriptorAvailable=false and empty groups. No default type is substituted.
- This read-only operation returns group metadata, not setting/state values or editing rights.
### Errors
- 400: invalid/foreign unit KID. 401: sign in again. 403: missing tab/scope/read access. 404: missing or retention-hidden location/unit. 503: storage unavailable.
- Accept-Language localizes names/cycle labels; group identifiers remain language independent.

get.summary: Read the declared settings or states in one authorized unit group.
get.description:
### Access
- Same active manager, Tab, location grant, Location Read, Unit Read and RetentionDays checks as GetUnitOverview.
- `kind` is settings or states. `group` is an exact identifier returned by GetUnitOverview. The server selects fields from the effective unit type, never from client-supplied setting IDs.
### Values and limits
- Bounded Log24 reads for declared current-unit fields; newest MS2000 per field, no default substitution. Settings join the exact bank Log2 record for `sync` (only 1 means acknowledged) and batch current Log7 editor names/icons into `changedBy`. Missing sync is null, never success.
- `changedBy` is null when no editor is recorded (UserId zero); display no user icon or name in that case. Unknown nonzero editors retain their display identity even without a KID.
- `canReadHistory` identifies fields supported by GetUnitSettingHistory. Fetch history only on demand. Sync-only changes and editor label changes do not invalidate the value revision or change MS2000.
- `hasHistory` indicates that the setting has at least one bank Log2 history record. Show history controls only when both canReadHistory and hasHistory are true.
- Settings include `canEdit`, per-field `revision` and input constraints. Use SetUnitSetting to save; Unit Write is required. States are always read-only. Dynamic-option and other-scope editors are not supported.
- `valueStatus` is stored, missing, other-scope or redacted. A stored null/empty value remains stored. MainUnit/other-object bindings have no value; this endpoint does not infer their owning KID or borrow the current unit's value.
- Hidden settings are omitted; credential settings are redacted and never read. Enum field/group names are stable identifiers.
- At most 512 stored fields and 16,384 characters per value; ambiguous or oversized data fails with 503, never partial results. Values are uncached; type/location snapshots retain their normal 10/60-second limits. Poll settings at most every five seconds and states every ten seconds, pausing hidden pages and never overlapping requests.
### Errors
- 400: invalid kind, group syntax or unit KID/site. 401: sign in again. 403: missing tab/scope/read permission. 404: missing/retention-hidden unit/location or group not declared for this type. 503: storage unavailable or invalid bounded response.

get.summary: Read a bounded page of changes to one declared unit setting.
get.description:
### Access and scope
- Same manager, assigned Tab, location grant, Location Read, Unit Read and RetentionDays checks as GetUnitGroup.
- The group and exact setting identifier must be declared for this unit type and bound to the current unit. Hidden/credential/other-scope fields are not exposed.
- Audit access exposes only editor KID, kind, current display name and icon; it grants no access to their account or directory. Manager/service labels use bank zero; installer labels use the site's tenant bank; resident labels use this unit's bank.
### Paging and values
- Newest first from bank Log2, with stored value, source MS2000, Sync and editor. Names/icons are current Log7 labels, not historical snapshots. Unknown editors have a null KID and may have an empty name.
- `changedBy` is null for UserId zero; display no user icon or name in that case.
- `limit` is 1–50 (default 25). Pass `nextBeforeMs2000` as `beforeMs2000` for the next page. Null means no more rows. No count query, defaults or cache.
- Sync is the flag on that exact Log2 record: only 1 means acknowledged. Null means no known flag, never success. A sync-only update does not change the value revision or modification timestamp.
- Fetch history on demand, not once per visible row. At most 16,384 characters per value; oversized/ambiguous data fails the whole page.
### Errors
- 400 invalid input/site; 401 login required; 403 missing access; 404 hidden unit/location or unsupported field/group; 503 storage failure. All storage work has an eight-second deadline.

get.summary: Resolve up to 32 visible unit icons, adding the online/offline under-icon on demand.
get.description:
Repeat the kid query parameter with canonical unit KIDs from this site. Requires the same active
manager, assigned Tab, location scope, Location Read, Unit Read and RetentionDays visibility as GetLocationUnits.
Only after authorization, reads this site's Alive rows by exact bank/location (cached up to 10 seconds).
Offline=1 sets Kid.Icons[1] to eIcon.error; Offline=0 sets it to eIcon.check.
Missing rows, null and other Offline values retain the configured icon without a status decoration.
UnitId text, primary icon and other presentation fields are preserved. Never infers offline from Cycle or MainId.
Returns items with kid, opaque iconKid, nullable offline (null for missing/unknown Alive), and status.
Per-item 403/404/503 has null iconKid/ offline; never interpret a failed lookup as online.
Invalid/foreign/bulk input returns 400, expired sessions 401. Response is no-store. No writes.
Fetch only displayed icons, batch duplicate KIDs, poll at most every 10 seconds and pause hidden pages.
Use iconKid unchanged with GetIconFromSet. The public image endpoint itself never looks up Alive.

get.summary: Resolve up to 32 visible location icons with their units' combined online/offline status.
get.description:
Repeat kid with canonical location KIDs from this site. Requires the same active manager, assigned
Tab, location scope, Location Read, Unit Read and RetentionDays visibility as GetLocationUnits.
Only the units returned by that authorized overview contribute; hidden units and orphan Alive rows do not.
Any included unit with Alive.Offline=1 sets offline=true and Kid.Icons[1]=eIcon.error.
A nonempty set whose every unit has Alive.Offline=0 sets offline=false and Kid.Icons[1]=eIcon.check.
Otherwise offline=null: empty locations or incomplete/unknown Alive data do not claim to be online.
Missing status never overrides a confirmed offline unit. Primary icon, LocationId text and other fields stay intact.
Items contain kid, opaque iconKid, nullable offline and status. Per-item 403/404/503 returns no icon/status.
Invalid/foreign/oversized input returns 400, expired sessions 401. A failed lookup never means online.
Read only visible icons, batch/deduplicate and refresh at most every 10 seconds; pause hidden pages.
Alive reads share the bounded ten-second cache with GetUnitIcons. HTTP is no-store. No writes.
Use iconKid unchanged with GetIconFromSet; the anonymous image endpoint never queries Alive.

get.summary: Read grouped opening hours, upcoming exceptions and the current opening status for a location.
get.description:
Requires the same active manager, assigned Tab, Location Read, Unit Read, site/KID scope and RetentionDays
visibility as GetLocationUnits. Authorization precedes the opening-hours read. Only visible units can own or
inherit schedules. The tenant is selected by site configuration, never by the caller.
            
One bounded Log24 read, at most 255 units / 32,768 values, an eight-second deadline and two concurrent reads.
No Alive reads or writes. MasterUnitId comes from Log24 states. Missing/hidden/cyclic owners yield Unknown,
never assumed 24/7. A known controller with no weekly limits is AllDay. Open/close fields inherit independently
backwards through the week; an entirely unset unit week inherits its controller's plan. Explicit unit exceptions
remain in effect. Equal explicit times are Closed; short openings are preserved. Overnight intervals are supported.
            
Weekly rows use ISO weekdays 1–7. Exceptions are concrete local dates from today through two calendar months,
including year boundaries. First Wednesday, configured holidays (including the legacy Great Prayer Day), then
Custom3/Custom2/Custom1 take precedence. Custom1 wins duplicate dates; Feb 29 applies only in leap years.
An explicit date exception replaces overnight spill from the previous day.
            
Status values: Open, Closed, AllDay, Unknown. Times are HH:mm with closesNextDay. isOpenNow is nullable;
nextChange carries a UTC offset and is null for unknown/no transition within the next 369 days. This describes
the schedule only, not equipment readiness, permissions or a guarantee that the premises are accessible.
Location TimeZoneId/legacy TimeZone precede bank values; missing zones default to Europe/Copenhagen. Invalid
zones return 503. DST gaps advance to the first valid minute; repeated times use first opening/last closing.
Names and day labels use Accept-Language. calculatedAt identifies the observation; refresh on page navigation.
            
400 invalid KID/site; 401 expired/inactive session; 403 missing scope/tab/read permissions;
404 missing/retention-hidden location; 503 unavailable, invalid or oversized storage. Do not show 503 as closed.

post.summary: Create an empty enabled administrator with a previously unused manager identity.
post.description:
Requires Managers1, independent Managers Read and Create, and whole-tenant scope.
No request body or client-selected tenant/UserId. Rechecks the actor account, credential stamp
and access before allocation and again inside the write transaction, holding account and access locks through commit.
No password, email, tabs or scopes are assigned;
no invitation is sent. Use GetManager and the existing editing operations after creation;
profile edits additionally require Managers Write.
Finds the next unused manager identity and appends only Enabled=1. No Deleted setting is written.
No random marker, intentional delay or reservation verification. 15-second deadline.
A tenant-specific MySQL advisory lock serializes allocation through commit (up to 5 seconds to acquire).
All creators must use the same lock on the same writer, including AMS and FRA. No table lock or schema change.
Independent writers will use modulo allocation by ServerId with a fixed common modulus (ADR 0015; not implemented).
Creation is not idempotent; lock/storage failures return 503.
401: login required. 403: missing-managers-tab/read/create or missing-tenant-access.
409 manager-ids-exhausted: identity range exhausted.
503 manager-creation-unavailable: outcome may be uncertain; inspect the directory before manual retry.
Never automatically retry a timeout or lost response.

get.summary: List administrators in the site's eUserId.Managers through ManagersLast range.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager session, **Managers1 (28)**, **PermissionManagers2 Read** and an explicit **tenant-wide KID grant**.
- Bank/location-only grants are insufficient. Write does not imply Read; missing permission values default to Read.
- Every request checks the current bounded session snapshot, at most **60 seconds** old.
            
### Returned metadata
            
- Reads `Log7`, bank zero, without reading credentials for listed managers. Disabled managers remain listed.
- Deleted records follow the **caller's RetentionDays**.
- Resource grants contain only this site's valid scopes. Tab grants are metadata, not proof of effective access.
- `operationPermissions` and `retentionDays` describe the **listed manager**, never the caller.
- **Service** comes from `PermissionService2` (3017) and has independent flags; it does not grant login or other categories' permissions.
- The seven permission categories include **Installer** from `PermissionInstaller2`. GetInstallers requires Installer Read, Installers1 and tenant-wide access; GetInstaller uses the same read access and SetInstallerIcon additionally requires Installer Write; its flags do not authorize other resource categories.
- Missing `Permission*2` settings default to Read; malformed settings grant nothing. Missing, invalid or negative `RetentionDays` becomes zero.
- `isCurrentManager` identifies your own record. `canEditPermissions` requires Managers Write; on your own record it additionally requires that no other active manager has a whole-tenant KID grant. Use `SetManagerPermission` to save.
            
### Filtering and paging
            
- `filter` matches a case-insensitive substring of decoded **Name OR Email** before pagination. SQL wildcard characters are literal.
- Pagination scans at most `pageSize` candidates. A page can be short or empty while `nextCursor` is non-null; **continue until null**.
- Changing filter, sort, direction or page size requires restarting **without a cursor**.
- Concurrent inserts and changes are not a frozen snapshot.
            
### Ordering
            
- Selectable ordering uses a shared **seven-setting index**, cached for at most **60 seconds**, then reads fresh page details.
- `lastActiveAt` is the current Alive krumb's MS2000 converted to UTC, not its Text value. Missing/invalid times are null and sort first ascending, last descending. Reads do not update activity.
- Identity ascending retains its bounded database scan. All modes reapply authorization and deletion retention per page.
- Text ordering is ordinal and case-insensitive. Kids compare sorted, site-relative numeric bank/location scopes; empty lists come first.
- Enabled orders **missing, false, true**. Deleted orders by deletion time, zero first. Descending reverses ties as well.
            
### Limits and errors
            
- At most **20,000 matching identities** in the index. Larger selections return **HTTP 503** with `manager-directory-too-large`; narrow the filter.
- A missing continuation identity after index refresh returns **HTTP 400**, `invalid-cursor`; restart without a cursor.
- A cold index plus detail read has a **12-second deadline**. Data failure returns **HTTP 503**, never a silently truncated sorted list.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Candidate batch size, 1–100, default 50. Keep unchanged while following a cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation returned by the previous request, scoped to this site and caller.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional name/email substring, at most 128 characters, trimmed. Empty lists all permitted managers.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: identity (default), name, email, organisation, kids, deleted, enabled or lastActive. Applied before pagination.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: asc (default) or desc. Identity breaks ties in the same direction.

post.summary: Send an invitation allowing an existing manager to choose a password.
post.description:
### Access and target
- Requires an active manager, Managers1 (28), Managers Read and Write and tenant-wide access.
- The same own-profile lock and sole active tenant-wide manager exception apply as for profile editing.
- Current actor credentials/permissions and target visibility are rechecked under transaction locks.
- The target must be enabled, not deleted and have a valid saved email. Send the confirmed profileRevision; recipients cannot be supplied by the caller.
### Invitation
- HTTP 202 with code `invitation-queued` means the mail queue transaction committed; it is not a delivery receipt.
- Temporary delivery restriction: exact domains nortec.dk, kombinetech.com and arendt.dk receive directly; every other recipient goes to jens@arendt.dk. Cc/Bcc are cleared in every environment.
- A single-use link to the configured portal expires after 30 minutes and uses ResetManagerPassword. No password, Enabled, Tabs, Kids or rights change when sending.
- Language is en (default), da or es. Do not automatically retry an uncertain response: the mail may already be queued.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-manager-kid/invalid-invitation; 401 expired credentials; 403 missing rights/own-manager-permissions; 404 manager-not-found (including retention-hidden targets).
- 409 profile-conflict: reload after a concurrent edit. 409 manager-invitation-invalid: enable the target, restore it or save a valid email first.
- 429 invitation-rate: at most two invitations per target per 15 minutes per instance, separate from anonymous recovery. Follow Retry-After.
- 503 manager-invitation-unavailable: storage/configuration failure. Request bodies and link tokens must never be logged.

post.summary: Add or remove a tenant, whole-bank or single-location grant on an administrator.
post.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager, Managers1 (28), independent Managers Read and Write and explicit whole-tenant access.
- Own edits require being the sole active tenant-wide manager. All checks use the locked current Log7 snapshot, as for SetManagerPermission.
- The site supplies the tenant. Rejects foreign/noncanonical KIDs and resident, unit, tab or transaction identities.
            
### Selection
            
- Use SearchBanks and SearchLocations to discover choices; their existing Read, scope and retention checks still apply.
- Adding a Bank grants the entire bank and replaces its narrower location entries. A Location grants only that location.
- Adding the site's Tenant KID selects all banks and replaces all narrower grants on this site. Already covered additions are no-ops.
- Removing a grant removes only that exact scope. Removing all-banks does not restore previously replaced narrower entries.
- Stored site-relative grants are resolved against this site. Unrelated foreign stored entries are preserved but grant no access here.
- Adding a bank/location requires an existing exact Settings scope in this site's Log24, checked inside the transaction. Removing a stale grant is allowed.
- Kids do not grant tabs or operation flags. No account, profile, tab or permission settings are changed.
            
### Saving and concurrency
            
- Send kidsRevision as expectedRevision. One bank-zero Log7 history transaction reauthorizes, checks the revision, appends only changed values with the caller as actor and verifies the current-table trigger.
- Update the whole Kids display only after a valid 200 response. The response returns canonical site resourceGrants and the next kidsRevision.
- Removing your own whole-tenant access returns canEditKids=false; lock all editor controls. Actor/target sessions and directory indexes are invalidated even on uncertain outcomes.
- Existing session read caches on other API instances can live for up to 60 seconds; every write reauthorizes. The 12-second write deadline and sole-manager scan bound apply.
            
### Errors
            
- 400 invalid-manager-kid or invalid-kid-change: malformed/foreign identity, unsupported scope or missing/invalid boolean/revision.
- 401 requires login; 403 uses the SetManagerPermission access codes. 404 manager-not-found includes retention-hidden managers; resource-not-found means the selected bank/location no longer exists.
- 409 kids-conflict: reread and review. invalid-stored-kids: malformed stored grants are not overwritten. kids-limit: adding would exceed 1,000 grants; removals and broader replacements remain allowed.
- 503 manager-kids-unavailable or timeout: keep the previous display and reread before a manual retry. Never automatically retry an uncertain commit.

post.summary: Request a manager password reset email.
post.description:
### Recovery
- Send the existing login email and optionally language `en`, `da` or `es`.
- HTTP 202 with `code: accepted` is identical for unknown, ambiguous, disabled, deleted and throttled accounts.
- The link expires after 30 minutes, is tenant/environment-bound and cannot be reused after a reset.
