- The API uses its configured PortalWeb:BaseUrl; callers cannot supply a redirect URL.
### Temporary delivery lock
- Exact domains nortec.dk, kombinetech.com and arendt.dk receive directly; every other recipient goes to jens@arendt.dk. Cc/Bcc are cleared. The submitted address still identifies the account.
- Delivery is asynchronous through the existing Mails worker. A 202 does not guarantee delivery.
### Errors
- 400 invalid input; 429 IP limit (Retry-After); 503 unavailable configuration/storage. Never log request bodies or reset tokens.

post.summary: Replace a manager password using the emailed recovery token.
post.description:
### Reset
- Send token, password and confirmPassword. Use 12–128 printable ASCII characters with no leading/trailing spaces.
- The new password must differ from the existing password; the shared legacy password hash is retained for login compatibility.
- HTTP 200 `code: password-reset` means Log7 and a notification mail were committed together. Sign in normally afterwards.
- Changing the password invalidates existing manager sessions when rechecked (other API instances may cache them for up to one minute).
### Errors
- 400 `invalid-password` for the password policy; 400 `invalid-reset` for expired, used, wrong-site or stale tokens, inactive accounts or an unchanged password.
- 429 IP limit; 503 storage unavailable. Never automatically retry a reset with an uncertain outcome; try normal login or request a new link.
- The temporary delivery restriction also applies to the notification: only nortec.dk, kombinetech.com and arendt.dk receive directly; everything else goes to jens@arendt.dk, without Cc/Bcc.

post.summary: Replace all seven permission categories with a predefined administrator role.
post.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager, Managers1 (28), independent Managers Read and Write, and a whole-tenant KID grant.
- Own edits require being the sole active tenant-wide manager. The same fresh transactional authorization as SetManagerPermission applies.
            
### Presets
            
| role | Bank | Location / Unit / User | Managers / Installer / Service |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accounting (Regnskab) | Read (1) | Read (1) | None (0) |
| caretaker (Varmemester) | Read (1) | Read + Write (3) | None (0) |
| operator (Operatør) | All six flags (63) | All six flags (63) | All six flags (63) |
            
- Replaces the whole matrix, including clearing existing extra flags. Accounting also replaces Tabs with exactly Users2 (53), Account2 (2) and Settlement2 (40), removing every other ID, including unknown stored IDs. Other roles preserve Tabs.
- Kids, account state and profile fields are unchanged.
- A preset is a one-time assignment, not a stored or continuously enforced role. Individual checkboxes remain editable afterward if authorized.
- Applying accounting or caretaker to yourself removes Managers access. The response sets canEditPermissions=false; disable further editing. Operator enables all 42 checkboxes and retains Managers access.
            
### Concurrency and storage
            
- Read GetManager first. Send expectedFlags for all seven categories, using explicit null for invalid stored values. Accounting additionally requires expectedTabsRevision copied from tabsRevision; older clients must send this property before applying accounting.
- Requests must contain all seven categories, including Service. Incomplete category sets are rejected.
- One serializable Log7 transaction validates every expected mask and the Tabs revision before writing, appends only changed settings with the caller as actor, and verifies every current-table trigger. There are no partial permission/tab updates.
- Every role response includes tabs, tabsRevision, canEditTabs and canEditPermissions. Validate all returned permissions and tabs before changing the display; use the new tabsRevision for the next edit.
- Update the whole display only after a valid 200 response. Session cache invalidation also applies to uncertain outcomes.
            
### Errors
            
- 400 invalid-permission-role: unknown role, missing/extra categories, invalid masks or missing/invalid expectedTabsRevision for accounting. Invalid tenant/KID returns invalid-manager-kid.
- 401 requires login. 403 uses the same permission codes as SetManagerPermission, including own-manager-permissions. 404 manager-not-found covers absent or retention-hidden records.
- 409 permission-conflict or tabs-conflict: reload and review; nothing is partially saved. Accounting returns invalid-stored-tabs for malformed stored JSON/non-integer tab IDs without overwriting it.
- 503 manager-permissions-unavailable or timeout: keep the old display and reread before manually retrying; do not automatically retry an uncertain commit. The existing 12-second deadline and sole-manager scan bound apply.

post.summary: Set one administrator permission checkbox, including your own if you are the sole active tenant-wide manager.
post.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager, **Managers1 (28)**, independent **Managers Read and Write**, and a **tenant-wide KID grant**.
- Your **own** record is editable only when no other active, non-deleted manager has a whole-tenant KID grant; otherwise **403 own-manager-permissions**. All normal permissions above still apply.
- The exception counts managers regardless of their tabs and operation flags, using bank-zero `Kids`, `Enabled` and `Deleted`. Bank/location-only grants do not count. The check runs inside the serializable write transaction with locks, never from a cached count or filtered directory page.
- The actor's current Log7 account, credential stamp and access are rechecked inside the write transaction, without the session cache.
            
### Request and concurrency
            
- `resource`: Managers, Installer, Service, Bank, Location, Unit or User. Send a canonical manager KID on this site, bank zero.
- `flag`: one numeric bit: Read=1, Write=2, Create=4, Delete=8, RenameExtrenatId=16 or Rename=32. `enabled` is the desired boolean state.
- `expectedFlags` is required: send the category's flags from GetManager, including null for malformed stored values.
- **409 permission-conflict:** reload and review before retrying. Only the selected bit changes; no bit implies another.
            
### Storage and errors
            
- Appends bank-zero Log7 history with the caller as actor; verifies the current Log7 trigger before commit. No-op requests append nothing.
- Disabled targets can be edited. Missing or retention-hidden targets return **404 manager-not-found**.
- **503 manager-permissions-unavailable:** write storage is unavailable, unconfigured or nontransactional, or the sole-manager scan exceeds 20,000 candidate scope records. Do not automatically retry an uncertain result; read GetManager first.
- Success returns the authoritative category and invalidates the target's local session cache. Other instances' read caches may take up to 60 seconds; permission writes always use fresh authorization.

post.summary: Change Name, Organisation, Enabled, Deleted, RetentionDays, Icon or Email on an administrator.
post.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active account, Managers1 (28), independent Managers Read and Write and whole-tenant access. Own edits require the sole active tenant-wide manager exception. No extra Delete/Rename flag is required for these seven fields.
- Every write rechecks the locked current actor account, credential stamp, tab and permissions, plus target existence and caller deletion retention. No cached edit hint grants access.
            
### Values and saving
            
- Read GetManager and send its profileRevision as expectedRevision. Field names are case-sensitive: Name, Organisation, Enabled, Deleted, RetentionDays, Icon, Email. Only the selected field changes.
- Name/Organisation accept a string up to 200 characters with no control characters; empty clears the field. Whitespace and Unicode are preserved. RetentionDays accepts a nonnegative 32-bit integer. Enabled and Deleted accept true/false, not numbers or strings.
- Email accepts one plain ASCII internet address, up to 254 characters. The local part has at most 64 characters without leading/trailing/consecutive dots. The domain requires at least two DNS labels, each 1–63 letters/digits/hyphens without a leading/trailing hyphen; international domains use punycode. Whitespace, controls, quoted local parts, address literals and display-name syntax return 400 invalid-profile-change before storage. This checks format, not mailbox existence. Case is preserved. This changes the login address without changing the password or revoking existing sessions; no verification or invitation message is sent. Existing duplicate-email login behavior is unchanged (email plus password must identify one account). The response includes the confirmed email.
- Icon accepts an exact, case-sensitive eIcon name whose metadata is eIconSubject.Person. Read availableIcons from GetManager; an existing non-Person icon appears first for display only. Numeric values, URLs and new non-Person assignments return 400. Responses include saved icon and updated availableIcons. No-op clicks on the selected legacy icon should not send a write.
- Enabled is stored as 1/0. Deleted=true stores the database server's current MS2000 (milliseconds since 2000-01-01 UTC); Deleted=false stores 0. Repeated true preserves the original deletion time. Clients cannot choose the timestamp; 1 is never written as a new deletion marker.
- Write-time deletion retention and the confirmed canEditProfile hint use that same database clock, so clock differences cannot lock a freshly deleted target that remains within caller retention.
- Uses the shared serializable bank-zero Log7 history writer with actor attribution and verified current-value trigger. Unchanged values add no history. Other settings and the password remain unchanged.
- Update the UI only after a complete valid 200 response. Use its profileRevision for the next edit. canEditProfile=false locks all profile, permission, role and tab controls after own deactivation/deletion or loss of target visibility. Deleting a target with caller RetentionDays=0 hides it on the next read; restoration requires a caller whose existing retention includes it.
            
### Errors and freshness
            
- 400 invalid-manager-kid or invalid-profile-change: foreign/invalid identity, unknown field, invalid type/range, missing revision. 401 requires login. 403 uses the same codes as SetManagerPermission, including own-manager-permissions. 404 manager-not-found includes retention-hidden targets.
- 409 profile-conflict: reread and review before retrying. The revision covers all seven profile fields, including their raw stored forms.
- 503 manager-profile-unavailable or timeout: keep the prior UI and reread before a manual retry. A lost response may follow commit; never retry automatically.
- Actor/target sessions and local directory indexes are invalidated even on uncertain outcomes. Other API instances may retain snapshots for up to 60 seconds. Existing sessions of a disabled/deleted target are denied on their next fresh authorization check. Every write rechecks immediately. The 12-second deadline and sole-manager scan bound apply.

get.summary: Read one administrator by canonical manager KID for a workspace shortcut.
get.description:
### Access and identity
            
- Uses the same active-session, **Managers1**, **Managers Read** and **whole-tenant grant** requirements as `GetManagers`.
- Reads only this site's `Log7`, bank zero. A bookmark is not permission.
            
### Visibility and result
            
- Disabled administrators remain visible; deletion retention still applies.
- **HTTP 404:** the exact manager is absent or outside retention.
- No passwords or activation credentials are returned.
- `canEditPermissions` is a display hint, never authorization. Your own record is unlocked only for the sole active manager with whole-tenant access and Managers Write; writes recheck this inside the transaction.
- `availableTabs` lists every known eTab except None/Length, with numeric aliases deduplicated and metadata ordering. Includes legacy/unimplemented pages; it does not grant access. Only GetManager includes this catalog.
- `availableIcons` is included only in GetManager: all eIcon names with eIconSubject.Person metadata, ordered by numeric identity. The current display icon is prepended when outside this catalog. It is display-only in that case; new assignments must be Person icons. Missing/unsafe stored filenames display as the user icon without rewriting storage.
- `tabs` remains the selected set. `tabsRevision` covers the complete stored setting, including unknown numbers. Use SetManagerTab with this revision to toggle one tab. `canEditTabs` follows the same fresh-write policy as permission editing.
- `canEditProfile` follows the same policy. `profileRevision` covers Name, Organisation, Enabled, Deleted, RetentionDays, Icon and Email. Use SetManagerProfileField to change one field; deletion time is set by the server in MS2000.
- `operationPermissions` also includes **Service**, from `PermissionService2` (3017). Its flags are independent and do not grant login or permissions in other categories.
- `operationPermissions` includes **Installer** from `PermissionInstaller2`, using the same independent flags and defaults as the other six categories. GetInstallers requires Installer Read, Installers1 and tenant-wide access; GetInstaller uses the same read access and SetInstallerIcon additionally requires Installer Write.

parameters.name: managerKid
parameters.description: Canonical manager KID in this site's manager range, bank zero.

get.summary: List other visible administrators with the same stored email as this manager.
get.description: Same authorization as GetManager. Exact trimmed, ordinal case-insensitive matching within this tenant; excludes the source and empty email. Disabled accounts are included; caller deletion retention applies. Candidate index is at most 60 seconds old, bounded to 20,000 entries; at most 100 matching candidates are reread from current Log7 before returning. Larger matches return 503 manager-directory-too-large, never a partial list. 404 when source is absent or hidden. 12-second deadline. No credentials returned.

post.summary: Log in with a manager email and password.
post.description:
### Sign in
            
- Send the **original password over HTTPS**; do not hash it in the client.
- Use `accessToken` in `Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}` when calling `GetCurrentManager`.
- The opaque token lasts **259,200 seconds (three days)**. Do not decode it as a JWT.
- Before expiry, use `RenewManagerSession` to replace it after user activity. No separate refresh token is issued.
            
### Tenant and access
            
- The API site's configuration selects the tenant, not the request.
- Credentials and current manager settings come from the site's `A{TenantId:D4}.Log7`, bank zero. Tenant 166 uses `A0166`; there is no fallback to another tenant.
- Missing Tabs or Kids do not prevent login. Inspect `GetCurrentManager` and explain missing access in your UI.
- If several managers match both email and password, the active, non-deleted manager with the newest `eSetting.Alive` krumb MS2000 wins.
  Missing/invalid activity ranks last; equal activity (including all unknown) is resolved by the lowest UserId.
  Login atomically clears Password on the other matching accounts; accounts with different passwords are unchanged.
  Without an active match, no cleanup occurs. Grants are never merged. Read `GetCurrentManager` for the selected identity.
            
### Errors and diagnostics
            
- **HTTP 401:** incorrect credentials.
- After password verification, **HTTP 403** distinguishes `disabled`, `deleted` and `account-settings`.
- **HTTP 429:** wait for `Retry-After` before another attempt.
- **HTTP 503:** credential storage or atomic duplicate cleanup is unavailable (also for more than 100 matching rows).
  Do not automatically retry an uncertain cleanup result. No token is issued before cleanup commits.
- Rejections may create sanitized internal diagnostics; these expose no additional account information to clients.
- Failed attempts include the API-observed IP. Server-side portals may send `X-Portal-Login-Client-IP` as **untrusted diagnostic metadata only**; it never changes authorization or rate limits.

parameters.name: X-Portal-Login-Client-IP
parameters.description: Optional IPv4/IPv6 address observed by a server-side portal for its browser client. Logged only as caller-reported metadata on failed logins, alongside the API-observed IP. Invalid/multiple values are ignored. Never changes authentication, tenant scope, local-login checks or rate limits.

post.summary: Renew an unexpired manager session for three days.
post.description:
Send the current bearer token and no request body. The site's current account state and password
stamp are revalidated through the same bounded (at most 60-second) snapshot as other operations.
Store the returned accessToken and expiresIn in place of the old session. Ordinary API requests
do not extend token expiry. Renew only after user activity, not from an unattended keep-alive timer.
Expired/revoked sessions require login (401); unavailable account storage returns 503.
Renewal preserves local-development restrictions and grants no additional Tab/KID/operation access.
Older token copies retain their original expiry; no separate refresh token is issued.

get.summary: Get your profile, permitted tabs, bank/location access, and operation permissions.
get.description:
### Profile and navigation
            
- Returns the manager information used by the portal's overview cards in **one request**. Reuse it for all cards and navigation on the current view.
- Optional `gravatarUrl` is the preferred profile picture. Use `iconKid` when null or the image fails (including 404); it is a display hint, never an access grant.
- Empty `tabs` means no permitted pages. `hasBankAccess=false` means no banks or locations on this site.
- `Banks2` (tab 5) is included when granted, like other recognized tabs.
- `tabs` and `tabDetails` follow `AttributeMetaSortOrder` on `eTab`, then numeric tab ID. Missing sort metadata has order zero.
            
### Permissions
            
- Missing permission settings default to **Read**. An invalid nonempty value yields `level=null` and all rights false.
- Operation permissions and tab ordering never expand `resourceGrants` or grant additional pages.
- No manager ID or tenant override is accepted.
- `operationPermissions` also includes **Service**, from `PermissionService2` (3017). Its flags are independent and do not grant login or permissions in other categories.
- `operationPermissions` includes **Installer**, from `PermissionInstaller2`, alongside Managers, Bank, Location, Unit and User. GetInstallers requires Installer Read, Installers1 and tenant-wide access; GetInstaller uses the same read access and SetInstallerIcon additionally requires Installer Write; these flags grant no other category's permissions.
            
### Caching and database indicator
            
- Rights and account state are cached for at most **60 seconds** per API instance. Requests do not extend this; do not poll continuously.
- `databaseAccess` is an informational Log7 read/append check shared for **10 minutes**, or **1 minute** when unknown.
- The indicator grants no manager rights, executes no writes and does not verify every bank, trigger or operation.
            
### Errors
            
- **HTTP 401:** expired/revoked token or inactive account.
- **HTTP 503:** permission data is unavailable.

post.summary: Assign or remove one available eTab on an administrator.
post.description:
### Access and choices
            
- Requires an active account, Managers1 (28), independent Managers Read and Write and a whole-tenant KID grant. Every check uses the locked current actor snapshot in the write transaction.
- Own edits require the sole active tenant-wide manager exception; otherwise 403 own-manager-permissions. This is the same policy as SetManagerPermission.
- GetManager returns availableTabs: all recognized numeric eTab values except None/Length, aliases deduplicated. Labels/names derive from enum metadata; existing and unimplemented pages are included.
- Tabs grant page access only. Kids, operation permissions and account status are unchanged.
            
### Saving and concurrency
            
- Send enabled plus the exact tabsRevision as expectedRevision. A stale revision returns 409 tabs-conflict; reread and review before trying again.
- Only the requested tab changes. Unknown numeric IDs and unrelated values are preserved. Malformed JSON or non-integer values return 409 invalid-stored-tabs without overwriting the setting.
- Writes use one serializable bank-zero Log7 history append with the caller as actor and verified current-table trigger. A no-op appends nothing. No writes to legacy tables.
- Update selected icons only after a valid successful response. Removing your own Managers1 grant returns canEditTabs=false and canEditPermissions=false; lock all editor controls.
- Actor/target session caches are invalidated even on uncertain outcomes; other instances may retain read snapshots for up to 60 seconds. Every write rechecks fresh authorization. The existing 12-second deadline and sole-manager scan bound apply.
            
### Errors
            
- 400 invalid-manager-kid or invalid-tab-change covers foreign/malformed identities, unavailable IDs and missing inputs. 401 requires login.
- 403 uses the same access codes as SetManagerPermission. 404 manager-not-found covers absent or retention-hidden targets.
- 503 manager-tabs-unavailable or timeout: keep the previous selection; reread before a manual retry because a lost response may follow commit. Never automatically retry.

post.summary: Save your own theme preference.
post.description:
### Value and access
            
- Send numeric `eThemeMode`: **System = 0**, **Light = 1**, **Dark = 2**.
- Requires an active manager session and matching credential stamp on this site. No manager, KID or tenant selector is accepted.
- This own-account preference needs no bank Tab, KID grant or resident-write permission, and grants no business access.
            
### Storage and refresh
            
- Writes require the site's configured write connection.
- Repeating the stored value creates no additional history.
- Success invalidates this API instance's profile cache. Other instances may take up to **60 seconds** to refresh.
- `GetCurrentManager` returns `themeMode`, defaulting to **System** when absent or invalid.

get.summary: Read your own personal settings and available person icons.
get.description:
### Access and fields
- Requires an active manager bearer session on this tenant with a current credential stamp. No Tabs, Kids or Managers Write are needed.
- Returns name, organisation, icon, email, emailVerified, numeric themeMode (System=0, Light=1, Dark=2), iconSet (g or line; default g), retentionDays, revision and availableIcons.
- retentionDays is the number of days deleted records remain visible within your existing access; 0 hides deleted records. Missing/invalid stored values return 0.
- emailVerified is proof of this exact current email log version, not an old or manually assigned flag.
- No target manager or tenant selector is accepted. Passwords and internal verification data are never returned.
- Reads use the site's read connection only; no configured write connection or MySQL write privilege is required.
### Errors
- 401 stale/inactive session; 503 unavailable storage. Responses are not cacheable.

get.summary: Read your own tab selection, available tabs and editing eligibility.
get.description:
Requires an active tenant-bound manager session. Returns kid, tabs, availableTabs, revision and canEdit.
Each tab has its stable numeric id and enum name. CanEdit requires an explicit all-banks grant for this site's tenant.
Bank/location grants, even several covering current banks, do not qualify. No Managers tab or Managers Write is required.
The catalog includes unimplemented tabs; choosing one does not implement its page or grant business operations.
Reading uses the site's read connection only. CanEdit describes manager authorization; saving still requires database write access.
401 invalid/revoked session; 503 unavailable storage. No cache and no credential fields.

post.summary: Select or deselect one of your own tabs when you have access to all banks.
post.description:
Send enabled (boolean) and revision from GetMyManagerTabs. tabId must be a concrete id from availableTabs.
The session selects the manager and tenant; request bodies cannot select another account or grant Kids/operation permissions.
Active credentials and an explicit whole-tenant KID grant are checked again inside the serializable Log7 transaction.
No Managers tab or Managers Write is required. You may remove any own tab and later restore it while the all-banks grant remains.
Preserves unrelated/unknown numeric tab values; identical selections append no history. Returns the committed selection and revision.
400 invalid-tab-change; 401 invalid/revoked session; 403 missing-tenant-access;
409 tabs-conflict or invalid-stored-tabs: reread before a manual retry; 503 unavailable/uncertain storage: never retry automatically.
Permissions are invalidated immediately on this instance; other instances refresh within 60 seconds. The portal refreshes workspace navigation after the confirmed save.

post.summary: Save one personal name, organisation, person icon, theme or deleted-record visibility preference.
post.description:
### Request
- field is the exact setting name: Name, Organisation, Icon, ThemeMode, RetentionDays or IconSet. Other settings are rejected.
- Send value (string for display fields, integer 0–2 for ThemeMode) and revision from GetMyManagerProfile or the last successful write.
- Name/Organisation allow up to 200 characters without controls. Icon must be in the person catalog; an existing legacy icon remains visible.
- IconSet requires the exact JSON string "g" or "line". It selects artwork only, not the IconKid or any permissions. Missing/invalid stored values read as "line"; an explicit saved "g" is preserved.
- RetentionDays requires a JSON integer from 0 to 2147483647. It controls visibility of otherwise authorized deleted records, not physical deletion. 0 hides deleted records; Tabs, Kids and operation permissions still apply.
- Saves to your own Log7 history only. Administrative self-edit locks and grants are unchanged.
### Response and errors
- 200 returns the acknowledged profile and new revision. Repeating an identical stored value creates no history.
- 400 invalid-profile; 401 stale/inactive session; 409 profile-conflict: reload before deciding whether to overwrite; 503 unavailable/uncertain storage.
- Do not automatically retry an uncertain write. Cache invalidation is immediate on this instance; other instances refresh within 60 seconds.

post.summary: Send a verification link to your new email address.
post.description:
### Verification
- Send email, currentPassword and optional language en/da/es. The current password is required even for a local development session.
- 202 email-verification-queued means the mail is queued, not delivered; the existing address stays unchanged.
- The trusted portal link expires after 30 minutes. Confirm it explicitly using ConfirmMyManagerEmail; a GET never changes an account.
- The link is bound to this tenant/environment and the current email, password and verification log revisions. Changing any of these invalidates it.
### Temporary delivery policy and errors
- Verification is currently available only for exact domains nortec.dk, kombinetech.com and arendt.dk.
- 400 email-delivery-restricted for other domains: redirected development mail cannot prove ownership of the requested address. The central mail restriction is not bypassed.
- Other 400 codes: invalid-email, current-password-invalid, email-already-verified. 401 invalid session; 429 rate-limited (two requests/15 minutes per account, plus IP limit); 503 unavailable.
- Never log currentPassword, request bodies or verification tokens. No caller-provided redirect URL is accepted.

post.summary: Confirm the new mailbox with its single-use verification token.
post.description:
### Confirmation
- Anonymous POST accepting only token; possession authorizes only this exact verified address change. No manager or tenant selector.
- 200 email-verified commits the email, a proof bound to its log version, and a notification to the former address together.
- Old-address notifications follow the central development recipient policy. The new-address proof is never sent to a substitute mailbox.
- Existing sessions keep their expiry and permissions. Sign in with the verified address next time. Password changes invalidate outstanding links.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-email-token for expired, used, wrong-site, stale or inactive-account proofs; 429 IP limit; 503 unavailable/uncertain storage.
- Do not automatically retry an uncertain confirmation; read your profile or request a new link. No token or email is echoed.

post.summary: Change your password after reauthentication and repeated new-password entry.
post.description:
### Password change
- Send currentPassword, password, confirmPassword and optional language en/da/es. The current password is always checked against locked current data.
- New passwords must match, differ from the old one, and contain 12–128 printable ASCII characters without leading/trailing spaces (shared legacy hash compatibility).
- 200 password-changed commits password history and notification mail together. Discard the old token and sign in again.
- Other API instances may cache old credentials for up to 60 seconds. The portal signs out after successful change.
- Notification mail follows the existing development recipient policy. Never log these fields or automatically retry uncertain writes.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-password, current-password-invalid or password-unchanged; 401 stale/inactive session; 429 rate-limited (two attempts/15 minutes per account plus IP limit); 503 unavailable.

get.summary: List concrete service enum identities, including services without saved settings.
get.description:
### Access
- Requires an active manager, Services1 (60), PermissionService2 Read and a whole-tenant KID grant.
- Write does not imply Read. Manager permissions alone do not grant service access.
- The bounded session snapshot is at most 60 seconds old; every request rechecks tenant, state and credential stamp.
### Catalog and storage
- Reads Name and Icon from this site's A{TenantId:D4}.Log7, BankId=0, in one bounded query.
- Every concrete eUserId in the service range is included, even without Log7 settings. Range-end markers are excluded.
- Identity is eUserId.ToString(). KIDs use the existing Manager type and bank zero, with the service ID allowlist.
- No API-key hashes are selected or returned. An absent/unsafe icon displays the server icon.
### Filtering and errors
- filter matches Identity or Name as a literal ordinal case-insensitive substring, maximum 128 characters.
- sort is identity or name; direction is asc or desc. Name ties use numeric identity. The finite catalog is returned once; nextCursor is null.
- 400 invalid-filter/invalid-sort; 401 revoked session; 403 missing-services-tab/read or missing-tenant-access.
- 503 services-unavailable on database failure or the 12-second deadline. No partial result and no automatic retry.

get.summary: Read one predefined service, editable metadata and its icon catalog.
get.description:
### Access and identity
- Same active-manager, Services1, Service Read and tenant-wide grant as GetServices.
- serviceKid must be a canonical bank-zero Manager KID for a concrete service enum value on this site.
- A service exists by enum definition, including before its first settings write. No identity is allocated.
### Editing metadata
- CanEdit additionally requires Service Write. Only these callers receive ApiKeyHash; readers receive null and HasApiKeyHash.
- ProfileRevision covers raw Name, Icon and Password, including row presence. It is not authorization.
- AvailableIcons contains known eIcon names; a safe legacy current icon appears first for display only.
- Hash values are opaque existing hashes, not plaintext keys. This operation does not implement service login.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-service-kid; 401/403 as GetServices; 503 services-unavailable. No-store, 12-second deadline.

post.summary: Save one service Name or Icon.
post.description:
### Access and validation
- Requires Services1, independent Service Read and Write, and a whole-tenant KID grant.
- Rechecks the acting manager's current account, credential stamp, tab and scope inside the write transaction.
- field is exactly Name or Icon. Value is a string. Name allows up to 200 non-control characters.
- Icon must be a known selectable eIcon name. ApiKeyHash cannot be supplied or cleared manually:
  field ApiKeyHash returns 400 invalid-service-profile, even with an empty value. Use GenerateServiceApiKey to replace the key.
### Storage and acknowledgement
- Appends one setting to this tenant's bank-zero Log7 history, with acting manager and database MS2000.
- Serializable transaction; verifies the current Log7 trigger before commit. Unchanged values add no history.
- Supply ExpectedRevision from GetService. Update UI only after the complete 200 response and use its new ProfileRevision.
- No login, token issuance, permission grant, other service setting or Alive update is performed.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-service-kid/invalid-service-profile; 401/403 as GetServices, plus missing-services-write.
- 409 service-profile-conflict: reload and review. 503 services-unavailable: outcome may be uncertain; reread before manual retry.
- Do not retry writes automatically. No-store; request maximum 4096 bytes; 12-second deadline.

post.summary: Generate a service API key beginning with kt_ and save its password-compatible hash.
post.description:
### Access and concurrency
- Requires an active manager, Services1, independent Service Read and Write and a whole-tenant KID grant.
- ExpectedRevision must match GetService. Authorization is repeated inside the same Log7 transaction as the save.
### Key and storage
- Generates kt_ followed by 64 cryptographically random ASCII letters and digits, always including both uppercase and lowercase letters. Total length is 67 characters. Keys are case-sensitive.
- Uses exactly the existing manager password hashing function (HubManager.SHA512Salt compatible).
- Only the resulting 128-character uppercase hash is stored as eSetting.Password, like manager passwords. Replaces the previous hash.
- The response keeps its existing apiKeyHash/hasApiKeyHash names; these describe the Password value, not a separate storage field.
- The plaintext key appears only in this successful response, alongside the committed details and next revision.
- GetService cannot recover it. Copy it before leaving the page; never log the key or response, or store it in browser storage.
- Does not issue bearer tokens. This is the only operation for replacing the stored API-key hash; manual profile hash writes are rejected.
### Errors
- 400 invalid-service-kid/invalid-service-profile; 401 revoked session; 403 missing service tab/read/write or tenant access.
- 409 service-profile-conflict: reread and review. 503 services-unavailable: the outcome can be uncertain; no key is returned.
- Never retry automatically. Reread before generating again after a lost response; a new generation replaces the key.
- No-store, 12-second deadline, maximum 4096-byte request. UI must not offer a key as saved before the complete 200 response.

get.summary: Lists 25 closed settlement periods, newest first, and the next scheduled settlement.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires **Settlement2**, **Bank Read**, **User Read** and access to the **entire bank**.
- Location-only access cannot expose bank-wide totals.
            
### Results and paging
            
- Returns **25 closed periods**, newest first, plus the next scheduled settlement.
- Follow `nextBeforePeriod` to read older periods. Unknown metadata is null.
- `amountMinor` is the signed stored sum, not a recalculated export total or a major-unit currency amount.
            
### Cache and effects
            
- Metadata is cached for at most **60 seconds**.
- No writes, settlement jobs or notifications are performed.

get.summary: Reads grouped totals for one period (zero is the provisional current period) and lists available export formats.
get.description:
### Access and amounts
            
- Uses the same **full-bank permissions** as `GetBankSettlements`.
- Returns grouped totals and available export formats. **Currency groups are never merged.**
- Uses current user metadata.
            
### Provisional data and cache
            
- Period **0** is the provisional current period and may change before settlement.
- Settlement is exempt from **RetentionDays**.
- Source data is cached for at most **one minute**.

get.summary: List Offline and AutoOutOfOrder alerts, newest first, using parallel lookups.
get.description:
Requires an active manager, TenantStatus1 (80), Bank Read, Location Read, Unit Read and matching
site/bank/location KID grants. Each request checks the bounded manager snapshot (at most 60 seconds old).
No tenant selector is accepted. Grants and RetentionDays for bank/location/unit are applied before LIMIT.
Locations require Enabled exactly 1. Missing Deleted means zero; malformed/future deletions are hidden.
Offline reads the site's Alive rows with UnitId=MainId, excluding Cluster Test, using last server contact:
Cash at least one hour old; other nonempty BankType at least one day old; at most 100 days old, inclusive.
AutoOutOfOrder reads Log24 OutOfOrder with value AutoOutOfOrder; excludes StartSMS_60 and TimeSMS_61.
UnitType2 takes precedence; otherwise the legacy packed type uses (value shifted right 1) AND 255.
Unknown/missing types are excluded from AutoOutOfOrder. ErrorId is the positive integer Id in the state JSON.
Names resolve localization placeholders using Accept-Language. All identities are canonical KIDs.
bankIconKid and locationIconKid are ready-to-render bank/location icons from Log24;
missing/invalid settings use bank_building/house. The API adds the object number to Kid.Text.
TimestampUtc means last contact for Offline and the OutOfOrder setting timestamp for AutoOutOfOrder.
limit is per source, 1–1000 (default 200). Sources hasMore explicitly reports truncation; there is no cursor.
Items sort by timestamp descending, then kind and KID. The same unit may appear for both kinds.
Sources run concurrently on separate connections within a 12-second request deadline. A failed lookup
has errorCode=status-source-unavailable and no items; successful sources remain available in HTTP 200.
If all lookups fail, HTTP 503 tenant-status-unavailable is returned. Never interpret a partial result as healthy.
Clients must tolerate additional source kinds. Refresh after 30 seconds; no overlapping or hidden-page polling.
400 invalid-limit; 401 invalid/revoked session; 403 missing-status-tab, missing-bank-read,
missing-location-read, missing-unit-read or missing-resource-access. Responses are no-store.

get.summary: Read 25 status rows at a time with next/previous cursors.
get.description:
Same authorization, visibility and source failures as GetTenantStatus. pageSize is 1–100 (default 25).
Without cursor, reads a fresh bounded snapshot (1,000 rows per source). Sources counts describe that snapshot,
not just the page; hasMore still reports source truncation. Status.items contains only this page.
Copy previousCursor/nextCursor unchanged with the same pageSize and language. Snapshots last at most two minutes
and may be evicted earlier. Every page rechecks credentials, Tab, operations, resource scope and RetentionDays.
Cursors are manager/site/scope/language bound and never grant access. HTTP is no-store.
For a 30-second refresh omit cursor. Optional offset (0–1999) and anchor (Kind:Kid, at most 300 characters)
preserve the visible position: the anchor is matched only among authorized results; otherwise offset is clamped.
Do not combine cursor with offset/anchor. 400 invalid paging input/cursor, 409 changed cursor context,
410 expired/evicted snapshot: restart without cursor. 401/403/503 retain GetTenantStatus meanings.

get.summary: Read a document's table as JSON with original values and column metadata.
get.description:
### Access
- Active manager bearer session; at least one of WashDoc1 (54), WashDoc3 (55), WashDoc2 (75); Location Read and Unit Read.
- Requires a tenant/bank/location grant matching the canonical document KID. The site's tenant is fixed.
- Location and unit deletion follow RetentionDays, including on SVG cache hits.
### Fields and values
- Optional `states`/`settings`: comma-separated exact enum names declared for this unit type. Omit for all permitted fields; an empty value selects none.
- Hidden, credential, unbound and other-object fields are never read. Unknown types return 422. Invalid/unavailable fields return 400.
- Rows use exact MS2000 timestamps, with cells indexed by column position. Null cell means absent; a cell with null text/value is a stored null.
- `text` preserves the decoded original; `value` is a finite double when possible. No interpolation or rounding. Use text for exact large numbers.
- `finished` requires a terminal Cycle and an InSync timestamp at least two minutes beyond the document end.
### Limits and errors
- One document, at most 31 days, 128 columns, 50,000 source samples and 500,000 cells. A 12-second storage deadline applies.
- 400 invalid KID/selection; 401 inactive/expired session; 403 missing access; 404 missing/hidden object or document; 422 unsupported type/oversized document; 503 storage unavailable.
- Tables and downloads are uncached. Original enum identifiers and UTC timestamps are language independent.

parameters.name: States
parameters.description: Exact comma-separated eState names; omit for permitted states or empty for none.

parameters.name: Settings
parameters.description: Exact comma-separated eSetting names; omit for permitted settings or empty for none.

get.summary: View a document as a printable HTML table.
get.description:
### Access and data
Same KID, authorization, field selection and bounds as GetUnitDocumentTable. Requires a manager bearer token.
### Output
Standalone HTML with UTC timestamps, original text, fixed English labels and no scripts or external resources. No interpolation. Browser caching is disabled.

parameters.name: Settings
parameters.description: Exact comma-separated eSetting names; omit for permitted settings or empty for none.

get.summary: Render a document's numeric series as an SVG chart, caching completed documents privately.
get.description:
### Access
Same authorization as GetUnitDocumentTable, reapplied before every cache lookup. Download with bearer authentication; this is not a public image URL.
### Graph
Same field selection; at most 16 numeric series, one labelled scale per series. Width is 480–2400 pixels (default 1200).
The SVG uses UTC timestamps, native lines and steps for enums/booleans, with no scripts, external resources or third-party SVG renderer.
Missing stored values break a line; sparse timestamps for other series do not. No fabricated samples or smoothing. 422 means no numeric data or too many series; select fewer fields.
### Cache
Only finished=true results enter the private disk cache, for at most 24 hours. In-progress data is read/rendered again.
Keys include tenant-bound document KID, unit type/name, exact ordered field selection, width and renderer version.
Server cache is bounded to 128 MiB/256 files. Cache I/O failure still permits uncached rendering. HTTP responses always use no-store so revoked access cannot be bypassed by browser/CDN caches.

parameters.description: Exact comma-separated eState names; omit for permitted states or empty for none.

parameters.name: Settings
parameters.description: Exact comma-separated eSetting names; omit for permitted settings or empty for none.

post.summary: Save one editable current-unit setting with revision protection.
post.description:
### Access
- Requires an active manager, an assigned Tab, matching location grant, Location Read, Unit Read and Unit Write.
- Account, credential, permissions, retention and effective unit type are rechecked under database locks before writing.
- Only fields declared in this type's setting group can be written. States, hidden, device-owned, read-only, ORM-managed, credential, MainUnit/other-scope and dynamic-option fields cannot be edited here.
### Request and result
- Send `value` as invariant text (maximum 4096 characters) and `expectedRevision` from GetUnitGroup for this field.
- Example: `{ "value": "Washer 1", "expectedRevision": "64 hexadecimal characters" }` for the Name setting.
- Descriptor required/type/range/pattern/select constraints apply. Boolean values become 0/1. Empty optional values remain empty; no defaults are inserted.
- Appends bank Log2 history with the editor's UserId and Sync=0. The Log24 projection must match before commit.
- Returns confirmed value, source MS2000 and new revision. A successful save means storage accepted it, not that the physical unit has acknowledged it.
### Errors
- 400 invalid input; 401 session changed; 403 insufficient rights/read-only field; 404 invisible unit/location/group; 409 value/type changed; 503 storage failure.
- On 409 reload before editing again. Never automatically replay after a timeout or lost response: a commit may have succeeded. Read back first.

post.summary: Read current and previous-period balances for up to 50 residents in one bank.
post.description:
**Read-only POST** returning current and previous-period balances in one batch.
            
### Access and request
            
- Requires an active site-bound manager, Users2, User Read and a bank-wide resource grant.
- Location-only grants cannot expose whole-bank balances.
- Send canonical user KIDs, not numeric IDs or readable aliases.
            
### Balance calculation
            
- **Current:** Log1 period zero, the resident discount and FlexOrm's missing-settlement correction for non-cash banks.
- **Previous:** the resident's highest positive period, which is not necessarily the bank's latest period. Period zero is never used as the previous period.
- Both balances reuse one grouped ledger read. An existing resident without transactions still has their discount applied.
            
**Delayed settlement** produces a provisional previous period with a capped discount. This also applies to cash banks, whose current balance remains unchanged.
The provisional number is the bank's highest Log1 period plus one. It is an estimate, not a stored/settled period or a settlement download identifier.
            
### Currency
            
- Prefer the `balances` array: normalized Log1 currencies stay separate, without conversion. A null currency remains separate too.
- The resident discount applies only to **DKK**. All currencies use the same resident previous period.
- An absent currency in an existing previous period has a zero balance; no previous period remains null.
- Scalar fields preserve the legacy cross-currency calculation for compatibility. Do not sum different currencies or use balances as a payment instruction.
            
### Posting and subscription metadata
            
- `latestPostingMs2000` is the latest Log1 posting across all periods and entry types, in UTC milliseconds since 2000-01-01; zero means no postings.
- `hasActiveSubscription` reports an active card/SEPA subscription, not payment success or a collection instruction.
- Both fields are null for missing/hidden residents and use the same authorized database snapshot as the balances.
            
### Missing data
            
- Missing or retention-hidden residents return `not-found` and null balances, never a fabricated zero.
- No previous period: `previousBalanceMinor` and `previousPeriod` are null; `previousPeriodIsProvisional` is false.
            
### Limits and errors
            
- At most **two concurrent batches** per API process.
- **20-second** database deadline; correction history is capped at **50,000 lines**.
- Timeout or oversized correction: the entire request fails with **HTTP 503**. Reduce the batch instead of displaying partial balances.
- For a lazy resident list, render the rows first, then request at most 10 residents per batch, one batch at a time.
  The API maximum remains 50. Do not block list rendering or sum different currencies.
- No database writes or shared balance cache.

get.summary: Suggest the next resident number from the bank's first NumberFormats entry and stored NumberFormatUserIndex (default 1).
get.description: Requires an active manager, Users2, User Read and Create, and bank-wide scope. Uses FlexOrm conversion, testing up to nine candidates and skipping occupied active numbers. Empty number means no suggestion. Read-only: no reservation or index update. Creation revalidates availability. Errors: 400 invalid bank, 401 session, 403 permission, 503 invalid stored format or unavailable storage.

get.summary: Suggest the next resident number after userNumber using the bank's first NumberFormats entry.
get.description: Same access and non-reserving behavior as GetBankUserNumberForNewUser. userNumber is required and must match the configured segment lengths and ranges; otherwise 400 number-format. Tests up to nine candidates; empty number means no suggestion. Missing format returns an empty number; malformed stored settings return 503.

get.summary: Read authoritative editing fields and an opaque concurrency revision. Bank-wide Users2/User Read required.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager, **Users2**, **User Read** and a **bank-wide grant**.
- Send canonical bank and resident KIDs belonging to this site and the same bank.
            
### Result
            
- Returns authoritative editing fields, permitted operation flags and an opaque concurrency `revision`.
- Use this revision when calling `ExecuteBankUserCommand`.
- **HTTP 404:** resident missing or outside the caller's deletion retention.

get.summary: Read the resident activation code for printing. Requires bank-wide Users2/User Create.
get.description:
### Access
            
- Requires an active manager, **Users2**, **User Read**, **User Create** and a **bank-wide grant**.
- Send canonical bank and resident KIDs belonging to this site and the same bank.
            
### Result
            
- Returns the active resident's activation code, name and number for printing.
- `qrCodeDataV1` contains the tenant URL and a FlexCipherLongs fragment with bank code, user code and UTC seconds since 2000-01-01, matching FlexORM GetQRCodeString.
- `qrCodeDataV2` uses the same URL and timestamp, with a fourth value (random noise, 0–1073741823) and a fifth value: 30-bit checksum = (((bankCode * 31 + userCode) * 31 + seconds) * 31 + noise) modulo 1073741824; reduce inputs modulo 1073741824 before arithmetic to avoid overflow. Decode with FlexCipherLongs.Parse(5, fragment) and verify the checksum. It is error detection, not authentication; existing version 1 consumers must explicitly support version 2.
- Encode the complete string unchanged as a QR code in the client; the API returns no image. Empty means no tenant activation URL is configured.
- Treat both codes as credentials: do not log, cache or send them to external QR services. Reload to obtain a fresh timestamp; validity is determined by the existing activation consumer.
- **HTTP 404:** resident missing or deleted.

post.summary: Execute profile, icon, attributes, tag, location, delete, restore or replace with the revision from GetBankUserWorkspace.
post.description:
### Access and revision
            
- Every command requires **Users2**, **User Read** and a **bank-wide grant**.
- Send the `revision` returned by `GetBankUserWorkspace`.
            
### Required User permissions
            
- **Profile:** Rename / RenameExtrenatId for the changed fields.
- **Icon / attributes:** Write.
- **Icon:** send `action: "icon"`, `icon` (an exact eIcon name with eIconSubject.Person metadata) and `revision`.
  Read `availableIcons` from GetBankUserWorkspace; an existing non-Person icon is display-only.
  The confirmed response includes `icon`, `availableIcons`, `canEditIcon` and the new `revision`.
  Numeric values, URLs and non-Person assignments return 400; deleted residents cannot be edited.
- **Delete / restore:** Delete.
- **Replace:** Delete and Create.
- **Create / tag / location:** Create.
            
### Conflicts and synchronization
            
- **HTTP 409:** reload and review the current data before retrying.
- Successful changes schedule existing backend synchronization, not instant hardware confirmation.
- Resident data and synchronization use **Log tables exclusively**. No notification or billing operation is executed.
- Disabled, unconfigured or nontransactional storage returns **HTTP 503**.

get.summary: Read complete receipts for one resident, newest first, twenty receipts at a time.
get.description:
Requires an active site-bound manager, Users2, User Read and a bank-wide KID grant.
The canonical resident KID cannot select another tenant. Deleted-resident retention applies.
            
The current and latest 24 stored period numbers are considered, within accounting/surveillance retention.
Purchases, payments, discounts and calculated transfers to rent are separate groups. Zero-total
documents and Month lines are omitted. Currencies are separate; no conversion takes place.
Amounts are signed minor units: a purchase is positive, a payment/discount normally negative.
Receipt balances exclude the unused current discount included in GetBankUserBalances.
Calculated adjustments have no transaction KID. Missing VAT or currency is null, never assumed zero/DKK.
OccurredAt includes the location's UTC offset; Date is its local calendar date.
            
First request: offset=0 without revision. Continue with nextOffset and the unchanged revision.
HTTP 409 receipts-changed requires discarding older pages and restarting at offset zero.
Offsets count entire receipt groups. No group is split between pages. No background polling is required.
            
Each request uses one read-only snapshot, at most 50,000 postings / 8 MiB of stored text and a
12-second storage deadline. Only two reads run concurrently per API process. Oversized history
returns 503 receipts-too-large, never partial totals. Missing/hidden resident: 404 not-found.
Other errors: 400 invalid-user/invalid-page, 401, 403 forbidden, 503 storage-unavailable/storage-timeout/storage-busy.

get.summary: Search resident Number, Name, Email, SMS and partial numeric TagId using current Log7.
get.description:
### Access and identifiers
            
- Requires **Users2**, **User Read** and site/bank/location grants.
- Only **BankId ≥ 1000**, ordinary users and records visible under **RetentionDays**.
- An exact canonical or readable resident KID (`tenant.bank-user` or `bank-user` with the trusted site tenant) uses an exact bank/user lookup; `matchedSetting` is `Kid`.
- Cross-tenant or inaccessible identities return no results.
            
### Text matching
            
- Query length: **2–128 characters**, literal and case-insensitive.
- **Number and email:** exact text.
- **Name:** substring matching.
- **TagId:** substring matching for positive decimal input; optional spaces are accepted.
- Use `SearchUserSms` for the independent complete-phone-number lookup.
            
### KID-only lookup
            
- `kidOnly=true` accepts only a complete resident KID and skips ordinary text search.
- Invalid input returns no items without business storage. Existing authorization still applies.
            
### Results and parent banks
            
- At most **50 resident matches**; up to **501 candidates** are checked.
- `hasMore` also asks callers to refine broad queries when the candidate bound is reached.
- `matchedSetting` and `matchedValue` explain each match.
- When Bank Read is granted, includes distinct parent banks with `isContext=true`.
- Limit and `hasMore` count residents. **Merge all result types by KID.**
            
### Deadlines and cache
            
- Name/Tag queries allow **10 seconds SQL** and **12 seconds including cache wait**.
- Cache: **60 seconds** per bank scope/query. Current permissions are reapplied.

get.summary: Search complete resident SMS numbers with indexed exact Log7 Text matches.
get.description:
### Access and matching
            
- Uses the same authorization, retention, parent bank context and result bounds as `SearchUsers`.
- Searches complete resident SMS numbers with **indexed exact Log7 Text matches**.
- Accepts **8–15 digits**, spaces, hyphens, parentheses and an optional leading `+` or international `00`.
- Danish eight-digit numbers match both with and without `45`.
            
### Independent lookup
            
- Runs independently of substring and TagId search.
- Does not decode activation codes or charge the activation-code quota.

get.summary: Decode an ordinary resident activation code and resolve name and icon from current Log7.
get.description:
### Access and lookup
            
- Uses the same permissions as `SearchUsers`.
- Codes contain bank/user, not tenant; the **trusted site supplies the tenant**.
- Resolves the ordinary resident's name and icon from current **Log7**.
- Invalid, missing, deleted-outside-retention or inaccessible residents return no items.
            
### Shared activation-code rate limit
            
- All bank, location and resident code endpoints share **5 calls per 10 minutes** and **20 per hour**, per manager.
- Invalid attempts count.
- **HTTP 429** includes `Retry-After`; wait before trying again.

get.summary: Displays Windows downloads for this tenant, or an explicit unavailable state.
get.description: Public HTML, no manager token or database access. Uses the portal's ten browser-selected languages, with English as the unsupported-language default. Installation still requires normal portal login; downloading grants no business permissions.

get.summary: Downloads a tenant-bound Windows App Installer file with update checks at launch.
get.description: Public. architecture is x64 or arm64. Download and open the file with Windows App Installer. 404 means no validated release is staged for this site's tenant/environment/architecture. Canonical HTTPS URLs come from trusted site configuration, never the request host. Beta and production have separate identities. Requires a trusted package signature and WebView2 Runtime on the device.

get.summary: Downloads an immutable signed Windows package, with byte-range and conditional request support.
get.description: Public binary download. Only exact filenames from operator-staged release metadata are accepted. 404 means missing, invalid or a different tenant/environment/architecture. Does not enumerate directories or accept arbitrary filesystem paths.

get.summary: Renders an angular color-gradient background at 200 × 200 pixels.
get.description:
### Access and colors
- Public presentation only; no login, KID, permissions or database access. Does not measure equipment status.
- `colors`: 2–4 colors separated by hyphens, such as `22aa88-ffcc33-ee4444`.
- Colors accept 3/6-digit RGB hex without #, exact eColor names, standard named colors or transparent (case-insensitive).
- Unknown colors return **400** with code `invalid-circle-parameters`; no color guessing.
### Rendering and cache
- Matches the legacy CircleGradient1 angular background: fills the viewport, begins at the bottom and turns clockwise.
- Pure SVG; no third-party graphics components, scripts, fonts or external assets. No raster formats.
- Fixed input means complete data: variants may be disk-cached for 24 hours, bounded to 512 files/32 MiB.
- Cache I/O failure falls back to rendering. Public HTTP cache: 600 seconds; ETag supports **304**.
- **429** means the per-process concurrency limit is reached; retry with backoff.

get.summary: Renders an angular gradient at a selected width and height.
get.description: Same colors, access and cache as GetCircleGradient. Width/height: 16–4096 pixels each; invalid sizes return 400. The gradient fills rectangular viewports. All inputs are path segments.

get.summary: Renders a progress circle with one square mark per percentage point.
get.description:
Public, parameter-only image at 200 × 200 pixels; same colors and cache as GetCircleGradient.
`background` fills the disc; `colors` is a 2–4-color gradient over the full 0–100 scale.
`percent` is an integer from 0 to 100; out-of-range values return 400, not clamped.
Marks begin at the top and advance clockwise, matching CircleProgress1. Zero has no marks; 100 has all 100.
The API renders the supplied percentage; it never reads or estimates machine progress.

get.summary: Renders a progress circle at a selected width and height.
get.description: Same parameters and cache as GetCircleProgress. Width/height: 16–4096 pixels; the disc stays circular and centered in rectangular viewports. Invalid parameters return 400.

get.summary: Renders a rotating semicircle to indicate running or indeterminate progress.
get.description: Public 200 × 200 SVG; same color validation/cache as GetCircleGradient, but one color only. Native CSS rotates once per five seconds, with no scripts or external resources. Reduced-motion preferences show a stationary semicircle. This presentation image does not query equipment status.

get.summary: Renders a running indicator at a selected width and height.
get.description: Same behavior and cache as GetCircleRunning. Width/height: 16–4096 pixels; the semicircle stays circular and centered. Invalid parameters return 400.

get.summary: Renders a linear gradient at 200 × 200 pixels.
get.description:
Public presentation only; no login, KID, permissions or database access.
Colors: 2–4 hyphen-separated 3/6-digit RGB hex values without #, exact eColor names,
standard named colors or transparent (case-insensitive), evenly spaced.
Angle: finite degrees, clockwise from left-to-right (0); 90 is top-to-bottom,
180 right-to-left, 270 bottom-to-top. Decimal angles use a dot; negative angles and full turns normalize modulo 360.
Pure SVG covering the full canvas; no raster formats, scripts or external assets.
Invalid parameters return 400 with invalid-gradient-parameters; malformed numbers use validation ProblemDetails.
Private disk cache: 24 hours, up to 512 files/32 MiB; cache I/O failure falls back to rendering.
Public HTTP cache: 600 seconds; ETag/If-None-Match supports 304. On 429 retry with backoff.

get.summary: Renders a linear gradient at a selected width and height.
get.description:
Same colors, angle, public access, errors and cache as GetLinearGradient.
            Width/height: 16–4096 pixels each. The gradient spans the full rectangle and retains its angle at the requested dimensions.
            All inputs are path segments. Example: /api/v1/gradients/linear/22aa88-ffcc33/45/800x400.svg.

get.summary: Resolve an IconKid, optionally changing its text, count or RGB colour.
get.description:
Send an exact eIcon name or canonical icon KID. Optional text (up to 128 non-control characters),
signed Int64 count and colour (0–16777215) replace only those fields. Other KID fields are preserved.
Calendar always uses today's day of month in Europe/Copenhagen, overriding supplied text.
Use the returned iconKid unchanged in /api/v1/icon/{iconSet}/{kid}.svg. An icon-only KID is returned
as its eIcon name. No login, lookup, grant or write; invalid input returns 400.
Read fresh metadata when refreshing the page; the image itself retains its normal cache policy.

get.summary: Lists canonical icon names with an asset in the requested local set.
get.description:
Public; no login or database access. Returns a sorted JSON array of eIcon names.
The set is case-sensitive (for example g or line). Only direct membership is listed:
unlike image rendering, this catalog does not include fallback assets from other sets.
Unknown sets return 404. Clients should intersect this catalog with the allowed icons
supplied by each business operation. The catalog grants no permission to change an icon.
Cached for ten minutes; retry 429/503 with backoff.

get.summary: Renders Kid.Icon from a named local asset set, with Kid.Count as the badge.
get.description:
Public; no login, business lookup or database access. KID fields never grant permissions.
Supply a URL-encoded canonical Kombine.Flex.Kid.ToString() value. Kid.Icons[0] is the main icon;
Kid.Icons[1] is the under-icon. A missing second entry or eIcon.none omits the under-icon.
Additional entries are ignored for rendering. The API also reads Kid.Count, Kid.Color and Kid.Text.
If KID parsing fails, an exact eIcon name (case-insensitive) uses count zero, black and empty text.
Numeric enum IDs, substring matches, malformed KIDs and undefined icons are not name fallbacks.
Count at or below zero hides the badge. Positive Int64 counts display in full; the red badge widens
with circular end caps and a straight middle, keeping its height and font size. Long labels widen the SVG canvas.
Choose iconSet explicitly: line or g. The g set preserves its original multicolor artwork.
Main and under-icon each try the chosen set, then other packaged sets in ordinal alphabetical order.
Unknown sets or icons absent from every local set return 404; no external or database fallback.
Kid.Color uses the low 24 bits as opaque RGB (0 = black; the high byte is ignored).
Kid.Text is case-sensitive, limited to 128 characters without controls and used by assets with a text box.
URL-encode path parameters. The canonical KID
is limited to 2048 characters; other path parameters to 128 characters without controls.
Formats: svg, png, jpg/jpeg, gif, bmp, tif/tiff, webp, ppm, tga and ico. Unknown formats return SVG.
Raster output defaults to 128 × 128 pixels; SVG retains its authored viewport.
First requests render to disk; repeated requests use the cache. Public cache: ten minutes.
ETag/Last-Modified support 304. Invalid parameters return 400; concurrency limits return 429;
unavailable rendering/storage returns 503. Retry transient errors with backoff.
Routes without iconSet and the separate count/color/text/sub path segments have been removed; see /docs#changelog.

get.summary: Renders Kid.Icon and Kid.Count from a named set at a square pixel size.
get.description:
Same KID/name fallback, access, asset lookup, formats and cache as GetIconFromSet.
Size is clamped to 16–4096 pixels (ICO at most 256). SVG retains its authored viewport.

get.summary: Renders Kid.Icon and Kid.Count from a named set with a raster background.
get.description:
Same KID/name fallback, access, asset lookup, formats and cache as GetIconFromSet.
Same size limits as GetIconImageFromSet. Background accepts Flex/known color names or 3/6-digit
RGB hex. Omit the background segment for transparent raster output. SVG ignores size/background.

get.summary: Renders a responsive Kombine symbol that fits its viewport without stretching.
get.description:
### Local artwork and access
- Public; no login, business KID, Tab, permission or database access.
- Original KombineLogo1 geometry, serialized with .NET XML; no graphics packages or external resources.
- The unsized SVG uses only a viewBox and `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"`: it fills the available viewport as far as possible without cropping or stretching. The background is transparent.
- No fixed width/height attributes are emitted. Use the width-specific route or set dimensions on the embedding element when a fixed pixel size is needed.
- `color` accepts 3/6-digit RGB hex without #, exact eColor names, standard color names or transparent, case-insensitively.
- Unknown colors return **400** with code `invalid-logo-parameters`; no substring or index guesses.
### Format and cache
- SVG only. All parameters are path segments, and the URL ends in .svg. No raster fallback.
- First request renders to a private disk cache; subsequent requests reuse it. All logo inputs are fixed, complete presentation data.
- Maximum 512 variants/32 MiB, 24-hour lifetime. Cache I/O failure falls back to fresh rendering.
- Public browser cache: 600 seconds; ETag/If-None-Match supports **304**.
- **429** means the limit of 16 simultaneous logo requests was reached; retry with backoff.

get.summary: Renders the square Kombine symbol at the selected width.
get.description: Same colors, access and cache as GetKombineLogo. Width: integer 16–4096 pixels; height equals width. Invalid width returns 400 instead of being clamped.

get.summary: Renders the Kombine symbol with an explicit background and width.
get.description: Same rules as GetKombineLogoSized. Background accepts the same colors as the foreground and is painted into the SVG. Use transparent to omit it.

get.summary: Renders the Kombine name and registered mark, without the symbol.
get.description: Original KombineText1 outlines are embedded locally; no installed or downloaded font is needed. No fixed width/height: the wordmark fits its viewport with the original 590:111 aspect ratio, centered without cropping or stretching. Transparent background. Same colors, public access, SVG-only format and cache as GetKombineLogo.

get.summary: Renders the Kombine wordmark at the selected width.
get.description: Same rules as GetKombineText. Width: integer 16–4096 pixels; height is width × 111/590, preserving the artwork. Invalid width returns 400. Transparent background.

get.summary: Renders the Kombine wordmark with an explicit background and width.
get.description: Same rules as GetKombineTextSized. Background accepts the same colors as the foreground and fills the SVG viewBox; transparent omits it.

get.summary: Renders the Kombine symbol and name together.
get.description: Original KombineLogoText1 composition, spacing and proportions. No fixed width/height: the logo fits its viewport with a 5:1 aspect ratio, centered without cropping or stretching; transparent background. Local path outlines, no fonts. Same color validation, public access, SVG-only format and cache as GetKombineLogo.

get.summary: Renders the combined Kombine logo at the selected width.
get.description: Same rules as GetKombineLogoText. Width: integer 16–4096 pixels; height is width/5. The artwork is never stretched. Invalid width returns 400. Transparent background.

get.summary: Renders the combined Kombine logo with an explicit background and width.
get.description: Same rules as GetKombineLogoTextSized. Background accepts the same colors as the foreground and fills the SVG viewBox; transparent omits it. Example: /api/v1/logos/kombine-logo-text/white/174d61/512.svg.

get.summary: Shows recent purchases as coin markers on a map. No login required.
get.description:
### Public scope and selection
            
- **No login required.** No tenant, bank or time-window override is supported.
- Returns a newest-first sample of purchases retained in **Log1Hour**, without a timestamp filter.
- `limit`: **1–200**, default **100**.
- This is a **visual sample**, not accounting data; missing coordinates can omit purchases.
            
### Amounts and identifiers
            
- Amounts are positive major currency units; currencies are not converted.
- Transfers and rows whose Text ends in `E` are excluded.
- `timestampUtc` is the original MS2000 converted directly to UTC.
- `kid` is a canonical transaction KID with the original timestamp. Use it to suppress duplicate animations.
- KIDs identify the tenant/bank/location/unit event, grant no permissions and contain no user ID.
- No names, tags or transaction text are returned.
            
### Refresh and errors
            
- One shared **10-second cache** per API instance. `refreshAfterSeconds` is always **10** on success.
- Failures use a **30-second backoff**. On **HTTP 503**, retry after **30 seconds**.

get.summary: Counts purchases in the site's Log1Hour without login.
get.description:
### Public scope and selection
            
- **No login required.** The site selects the tenant; no tenant or filter override is accepted.
- Uses `eUserId.Users` through `eUserId.UsersLast`, inclusive (currently **1001–99999**), `Text NOT LIKE '%E'` and `Amount < 0`.
- Counts **rows**, not distinct users.
            
### Time window and amounts
            
- **Log1Hour** holds recent transactions and is cleaned every minute by the database.
- The one-hour window depends on that maintenance. `sinceUtc` is the nominal start at measurement time.
- Count, `-SUM(Amount)/100` and `MAX(Currency)` are cached for **one minute** per API instance.
- No currency conversion is performed; `MAX(Currency)` assumes matching transactions share a currency.
            
### Errors
            
- **HTTP 503:** wait **60 seconds** before retrying.

get.summary: Counts active users in the site's current Log7 during the last 100 days, without login.
get.description:
### Public scope and count
            
- **No login required.** The site chooses the tenant; no caller-supplied KID, dates or filters are accepted.
- Counts distinct **(BankId, UserId)** pairs with **BankId ≥ 1000** and UserId **1001–99999** (`eUserId.UsersLast` inclusive).
- Activity means a current **Log7** record's `MS2000` exceeds the UTC **100-day cutoff**; it is not a verified login.
- No personal data is returned.
            
### Cache and errors
            
- Results are cached for **5 minutes** per API instance. Concurrent requests share one query.
- A failed refresh returns **HTTP 503**, not zero. Wait **60 seconds** before retrying.

get.summary: Gets public API availability. This does not check database readiness.
get.description:
### Availability
            
- **Public; no login required.**
- Returns the service name, availability and contract version.
- Checks API availability only; it **does not check database readiness**.
